slots.claim_sentence: Streptococcus pneumoniae is a leading cause of invasive disease in infants.
slots.clarification_sentence: This is especially true in low-income settings.

slots.claim_sentence: Asymptomatic carriage of Streptococcus pneumoniae in the nasopharynx is a prerequisite for disease.
slots.clarification_sentence: The variability in carriage duration is currently understood only at the serotype level.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers developed a model to calculate the duration of carriage episodes.
slots.clarification_sentence: This model used longitudinal swab data and whole genome sequence data.

slots.claim_sentence: Pneumococcal genomic variation accounted for 63% of the variation in carriage duration.
slots.clarification_sentence: Host traits like age and previous carriage accounted for less than 5%.

slots.claim_sentence: The study quantified variation in carriage duration from serotype, drug-resistance, and other locus effects.
slots.clarification_sentence: Serotype accounted for 17%, drug-resistance for 9%, and other locus effects for 7%.

slots.claim_sentence: A pan-genome-wide association study identified prophage sequences linked to decreased carriage duration.
slots.clarification_sentence: This link was independent of serotype and may involve disruption of the competence mechanism.

slots.claim_sentence: Prophage sequences are viral DNA integrated into the bacterial genome.
The model analyzed data from 598 unvaccinated children over two years.
These findings support theoretical models of pneumococcal competition and antibiotic resistance.

slots.claim_sentence: The study investigated how protein mobility depends on protein surface properties and ionic strength.
Researchers used surface-modified fluorescent proteins to determine their translational diffusion coefficients.
slots.clarification_sentence: These measurements were taken in the cytoplasm of Escherichia coli, Lactococcus lactis, and Haloferax volcanii.

slots.claim_sentence: In E. coli, protein diffusion depends on the net charge and its distribution.
slots.clarification_sentence: Positively charged proteins diffused up to 100-fold slower than negatively charged ones.

slots.claim_sentence: This effect of protein charge on diffusion is weaker in L. lactis and Hfx. volcanii.
slots.clarification_sentence: This is due to electrostatic screening in these organisms.

slots.claim_sentence: The decrease in mobility of positive fluorescent proteins is likely caused by their interaction with ribosomes.
slots.clarification_sentence: This was shown by in vivo diffusion measurements and confirmed in vitro.

slots.claim_sentence: Ribosome surface properties may thus limit the composition of the cytoplasmic proteome.
slots.clarification_sentence: The proteome is mostly negative in E. coli, L. lactis, and Hfx. volcanii.

slots.claim_sentence: This finding reveals a paradox in the functioning of prokaryotic (endo)symbionts.
slots.clarification_sentence: These organisms may struggle with slow diffusion and ribosomes swarmed with positive proteins.

slots.claim_sentence: Long INterspersed Element-1 (LINE-1 or L1) retrotransposition can cause mutations in human genomes.
Human cells have developed ways to control L1 retrotransposition.

slots.claim_sentence: APOBEC3A (A3A) is the most powerful inhibitor of L1 retrotransposition in lab cell tests.
However, deamination events were not found in L1 retrotransposition when A3A was present.
The exact way APOBEC3A (A3A) inhibits L1 retrotransposition was not understood.
This study used in vitro and in vivo tests.
slots.clarification_sentence: The tests showed that A3A can stop L1 retrotransposition by changing single-strand DNA.

slots.claim_sentence: This single-strand DNA is temporarily exposed during L1 integration.
slots.clarification_sentence: The L1 Element Amplification Protocol (LEAP) assay was used to study this process.

slots.claim_sentence: The LEAP assay recreates the first strand cDNA synthesis step of L1 integration.
The findings provide a mechanistic explanation for how the A3A cytidine deaminase protein inhibits L1 retrotransposition.

slots.claim_sentence: This study investigated the role of Rem2 in visual circuit plasticity.
slots.clarification_sentence: Rem2 is an activity-regulated, Ras-like GTPase, which is a type of protein involved in cell signaling.

slots.claim_sentence: Rem2-/- mice did not show normal ocular dominance plasticity during the critical period.
slots.clarification_sentence: Ocular dominance plasticity is the brain's ability to adjust visual input from each eye. The critical period is a key developmental window.

slots.claim_sentence: Rem2 regulates the intrinsic excitability of layer 2/3 pyramidal neurons in a cell-autonomous way.

slots.clarification_sentence: The causes would differ from those proposed by the authors.

slots.claim_sentence: Loss of Prospero prevents neuroblasts from entering quiescence.
slots.clarification_sentence: A pulse of low-level nuclear Prospero can induce proliferating larval neuroblasts to become quiescent.

slots.claim_sentence: The study proposes that different levels of Prospero distinguish three neuroblast fates.
slots.clarification_sentence: Prospero is absent for self-renewal, low for quiescence, and high for differentiation.

slots.clarification_sentence: Stargazin helps keep the receptor more compact.

slots.claim_sentence: Under synaptic conditions, AMPA receptors likely stay compact during gating.
slots.clarification_sentence: This happens with brief glutamate exposures and auxiliary proteins.

slots.claim_sentence: The precise roles that oxidants play in lifespan and aging are still unknown.

slots.clarification_sentence: This collapse affects over 80% of identified thiol-containing proteins.

slots.clarification_sentence: This finding goes against the free radical theory of aging.

slots.claim_sentence: The redox collapse is instigated by a substantial drop in cellular NADPH.
slots.clarification_sentence: NADPH normally provides electrons for maintaining cellular redox homeostasis.

slots.claim_sentence: This decrease in NADPH levels occurs very early during lifespan.
slots.clarification_sentence: It sets into motion a cascade predicted to down-regulate most cellular processes.

slots.claim_sentence: Caloric restriction increases NADPH levels.
slots.clarification_sentence: Caloric restriction is a near-universal lifespan extending measure and delays each facet of the cascade.

slots.claim_sentence: A quantitative redox proteomic approach was used to assess the timeline of events.
slots.clarification_sentence: This approach combined metabolic measurements with protein analysis.

slots.claim_sentence: These studies reveal a timeline of events.
slots.clarification_sentence: This timeline leads to system-wide oxidation of the proteome days before cell death.

slots.claim_sentence: In CFTR, ATP binding causes two nucleotide binding domains (NBDs) to dimerize.
slots.clarification_sentence: This dimerization opens the pore of the CFTR channel.

slots.claim_sentence: Spontaneous openings without ATP are rare in wild-type CFTR.
slots.clarification_sentence: However, in some CF mutants, this is the only way the channel opens.

slots.claim_sentence: The molecular motions behind spontaneous gating were unclear.
This study correlated energetic coupling between residues across the dimer interface.
slots.clarification_sentence: This was done during spontaneous pore opening and closure in single CFTR channels.

slots.claim_sentence: Spontaneous openings in CFTR are strictly coupled to NBD dimerization.
slots.clarification_sentence: This dimerization can occur even without ATP.

slots.claim_sentence: Coordinated NBD and pore movements are intrinsic to CFTR.
slots.clarification_sentence: ATP alters the stability of open and closed pore conformations, not their basic structure.

slots.claim_sentence: These findings provide insights for understanding CF mutation mechanisms.
slots.clarification_sentence: They also help understand drug mechanisms for cystic fibrosis.

slots.claim_sentence: The findings explain correlated effects of phosphorylation, mutations, and drugs.

slots.claim_sentence: This study presents a mechanism for a powerful force that drives the assembly and mobility of transmembrane proteins.
slots.clarification_sentence: Transmembrane proteins are embedded within lipid bilayers.

slots.claim_sentence: This force is a pre-transition effect related to the first-order phase transition in the membrane.
slots.clarification_sentence: This transition occurs between ordered and disordered phases within the membrane.

slots.claim_sentence: Large-scale molecular simulation showed that a protein stabilizes a microscopic order-disorder interface.
slots.clarification_sentence: This protein had a hydrophobic thickness matching the disordered phase and was embedded in an ordered bilayer.

slots.claim_sentence: When two such proteins approach each other, they assemble.
slots.clarification_sentence: This assembly reduces the net interfacial energy.

slots.claim_sentence: This phenomenon is called the 'orderphobic effect'.
slots.clarification_sentence: The orderphobic effect is analogous to the hydrophobic effect.

slots.claim_sentence: The orderphobic effect is influenced by proximity to the order-disorder phase transition.
slots.clarification_sentence: The protein's size and hydrophobic mismatch also mediate this effect.

slots.claim_sentence: The strength and range of forces from the orderphobic effect are significantly larger.
slots.clarification_sentence: These forces are larger than those from membrane elasticity for the membranes studied.

slots.claim_sentence: The Brazilian cave insect Neotrogla has a functional switching valve within its female genitalia.
Female Neotrogla possess a penis-like intromittent organ.
slots.clarification_sentence: This organ helps them coercively anchor males and obtain voluminous semen.

slots.claim_sentence: The semen capsule in Neotrogla is used for fertilization.
slots.clarification_sentence: The female also consumes the semen as nutrition.

slots.claim_sentence: The valve complex in Neotrogla has two slots for insemination.
slots.clarification_sentence: This allows continued mating while one slot is occupied.

slots.claim_sentence: The switching valve and female penis are morphological novelties.
slots.clarification_sentence: These enable Neotrogla females to compete for seminal gifts in their nutrient-poor cave habitats.

slots.claim_sentence: The evolution of the switching valve in Neotrogla may have been a prerequisite for the reversal of the intromittent organ.
Neotrogla is the only known animal with sex-role reversal where a female penis evolved.
Neotrogla is a minute Brazilian cave insect.

slots.claim_sentence: Synaptic SNARE proteins enable the rapid release of neurotransmitters.
slots.clarification_sentence: This process involves their step-wise assembly and depends on Munc18-1.

slots.claim_sentence: The functions of different assembly stages in exocytosis are not well understood.
slots.clarification_sentence: The role of Munc18-1 in SNARE assembly is also unclear.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers used optical tweezers to observe SNARE assembly.
slots.clarification_sentence: They found four distinct stages in the N-terminal, middle, C-terminal, and linker domains.

slots.claim_sentence: SNARE layer mutations affect SNARE assembly differently.
slots.clarification_sentence: The effects of layer mutations depend on their positions.

slots.claim_sentence: SNARE N-terminal domains (NTD) are responsible for vesicle docking.
slots.clarification_sentence: C-terminal domains (CTD) are responsible for fusion, and middle domains (MD) regulate assembly and fusion.

slots.claim_sentence: Munc18-1 initiates SNARE assembly.
slots.clarification_sentence: It also stabilizes the half-zippered SNARE complex, which depends on the N-terminal regulatory domain (NRD).

slots.claim_sentence: Munc18-1 structures the t-SNARE C-terminus.
slots.clarification_sentence: This structuring is independent of the syntaxin NRD.

slots.claim_sentence: SNARE domains have distinct functions.
slots.clarification_sentence: Munc18-1 intimately chaperones their assembly.

slots.claim_sentence: A major question is how the integrin adhesome can form complex cell-matrix adhesion structures rapidly, locally, and correctly.
slots.clarification_sentence: The integrin adhesome is a multi-protein structure that helps cells attach to their surroundings.

slots.claim_sentence: Adhesion sites assemble, disassemble, and change their molecular content by exchanging components with the surrounding cytosol.
slots.clarification_sentence: The cytosol is the fluid inside a cell where organelles are suspended.

slots.claim_sentence: The integrin adhesome is extensively pre-assembled in the cytosol as multi-protein building blocks for adhesion sites.
slots.clarification_sentence: This finding was made using fluorescence cross-correlation spectroscopy (FCCS) and fluorescence recovery after photobleaching (FRAP).

slots.claim_sentence: Stationary focal adhesions release the same types of protein complexes that they recruit.
slots.clarification_sentence: This process keeps the cytosolic pool of building blocks spatiotemporally uniform.

slots.claim_sentence: Multi-protein building blocks enable rapid and modular self-assembly of adhesion sites.
slots.clarification_sentence: These building blocks reduce the number of steps needed for assembly.

slots.claim_sentence: Symmetric exchange of multi-protein building blocks preserves their specifications.
slots.clarification_sentence: This preservation is crucial for the assembly logic of the system.

slots.claim_sentence: There are no spatial gradients of different protein complexes around focal adhesions.
slots.clarification_sentence: This indicates that stationary focal adhesions release the same types of complexes that they recruited.

slots.claim_sentence: Interpreting visual scenes typically requires people to accumulate information from multiple locations in a scene.
slots.clarification_sentence: Many situations require multiple fixations to extract several details at different locations to make a decision.

slots.claim_sentence: Participants' scan paths in a visual categorization task followed an active sensing strategy.
slots.clarification_sentence: This strategy incorporates information already acquired about the scene and knowledge of the statistical structure of patterns.

slots.claim_sentence: The study used a novel gaze-contingent paradigm.
slots.clarification_sentence: Small apertures of the image were revealed at each fixation location in this paradigm.

slots.claim_sentence: Categorization performance improved significantly when locations were revealed by an optimal Bayesian active sensor algorithm.
slots.clarification_sentence: This algorithm chooses the next fixation location to maximally reduce uncertainty in the category.

slots.claim_sentence: The Bayesian active sensor algorithm is optimal in minimizing categorization error with every single revealing.
A major portion of the apparent suboptimality of human fixation locations arises from prior biases.
slots.clarification_sentence: Perceptual noise and inaccuracies in eye movements also contribute to this suboptimality.

slots.claim_sentence: The central process of selecting fixation locations is around 70% efficient in this task.
Participants select eye movements with the goal of maximizing information about abstract categories.
slots.clarification_sentence: These categories require the integration of information from multiple locations.

slots.claim_sentence: Nucleocytoplasmic transport is tightly regulated by the nuclear pore complex (NPC).
slots.clarification_sentence: The NPC controls the movement of molecules between the nucleus and the rest of the cell.

slots.claim_sentence: Little is known about how very large cargoes are imported into the nucleus.
slots.clarification_sentence: The roles of multivalent binding to transport receptors via nuclear localisation sequences (NLSs) and cargo size are not well understood.

slots.claim_sentence: The study assayed nuclear import kinetics of 30 large cargo models.
slots.clarification_sentence: These models were based on four capsid-like particles, ranging from 17–36 nm, with up to 240 NLSs.

slots.claim_sentence: The model accurately predicted import rates for all tested cargoes.
A simple two-parameter biophysical model recapitulated the requirements for nuclear transport.
slots.clarification_sentence: This model correlates the import flux with the energetics of large cargo transport through the NPC.

slots.claim_sentence: The results reveal key molecular determinants of large cargo import in cells.

slots.claim_sentence: Cdc48 has a new function in the ubiquitin-dependent regulation of mitochondrial dynamics.
slots.clarification_sentence: Mitochondrial dynamics refers to how mitochondria change shape and move within a cell.

slots.claim_sentence: The deubiquitylases (DUBs) Ubp12 and Ubp2 have opposing effects on mitochondrial fusion.
slots.clarification_sentence: These DUBs cleave different ubiquitin chains on the mitofusin Fzo1.

slots.claim_sentence: Cdc48 integrates the activities of Ubp12 and Ubp2.
slots.clarification_sentence: Ubp12 and Ubp2 are themselves ubiquitylated, meaning they are tagged with ubiquitin.

slots.claim_sentence: Cdc48 promotes the proteolysis of Ubp12.
slots.clarification_sentence: This action stabilizes pro-fusion ubiquitylation on Fzo1.

slots.claim_sentence: Loss of Ubp12 stabilizes Ubp2.
slots.clarification_sentence: This stabilization facilitates the removal of ubiquitin chains on Fzo1 that inhibit fusion.

slots.claim_sentence: Cdc48 synergistically regulates the ubiquitylation status of Fzo1.
slots.clarification_sentence: This regulation controls the balance between activation or repression of mitochondrial fusion.

slots.claim_sentence: The study unravels a new cascade of ubiquitylation events.
slots.clarification_sentence: This cascade involves Cdc48 and two DUBs, fine-tuning the fusogenic activity of Fzo1.

slots.claim_sentence: The molecular mechanisms by which microbes manipulate host behavior are not well understood.
A lack of experimental systems for molecular manipulation has limited this understanding.
Researchers discovered a fungal pathogen, Entomophthora muscae, that infects wild Drosophila.
slots.clarification_sentence: They also developed lab methods to infect D. melanogaster, or fruit flies.

slots.claim_sentence: Lab-infected fruit flies show specific behaviors before death due to E. muscae infection.
slots.clarification_sentence: These moribund behaviors include climbing upward, affixing themselves, and raising their wings.

slots.claim_sentence: Raising their wings clears a path for infectious spores to launch from their abdomens.
slots.clarification_sentence: The flies extend their proboscides to affix themselves in place.

slots.claim_sentence: Entomophthora muscae invades the nervous system of infected flies.
slots.clarification_sentence: This suggests a direct way the fungus could cause behavioral changes.

slots.claim_sentence: The D. melanogaster system has an extensive molecular toolkit.
slots.clarification_sentence: This new system is expected to accelerate understanding of how E. muscae manipulates host behavior.

slots.claim_sentence: The fungus is present in the nervous system relatively early in infection.

slots.claim_sentence: Cilia and flagella are assembled and maintained by intraflagellar transport (IFT).
slots.clarification_sentence: IFT is a highly conserved mechanism involving more than 20 proteins.

slots.claim_sentence: The functions of individual IFT proteins are mostly unclear.
This study focused on the putative IFT protein TTC26/DYF13.
TTC26/DYF13 is an IFT complex B protein in mammalian cells and Chlamydomonas reinhardtii.
slots.clarification_sentence: This was shown using live imaging and biochemical approaches.

slots.claim_sentence: Knockdown of TTC26/DYF13 in zebrafish embryos resulted in short cilia with abnormal motility.
slots.clarification_sentence: Mutation of TTC26/DYF13 in C. reinhardtii also produced short cilia with abnormal motility.

slots.claim_sentence: IFT particle assembly and speed were normal in dyf13 mutant flagella.
slots.clarification_sentence: This finding is unlike other IFT complex B mutants.

slots.claim_sentence: Proteomic and biochemical analyses showed that a specific set of motility-related proteins was depleted in the dyf13 mutant.
slots.clarification_sentence: These depleted proteins were connected to flagellar motility, not flagellar assembly.

slots.claim_sentence: TTC26/DYF13 is not required for ciliogenesis or IFT particle assembly.

slots.clarification_sentence: These oncogenes also inhibit the apoptotic response to uncontrolled proliferation.

slots.claim_sentence: The EBV oncoprotein LMP1 activates NFκB.
slots.clarification_sentence: This activation is critical for the survival of EBV-immortalized B cells.

slots.claim_sentence: During early infection, EBV induces rapid B cell proliferation.
slots.clarification_sentence: This occurs with low levels of LMP1 and little apoptosis.

slots.claim_sentence: The study aimed to define the mechanism of survival early after EBV infection.
slots.clarification_sentence: This mechanism was investigated in the absence of LMP1/NFκB.

slots.claim_sentence: The study used BH3 profiling to investigate mitochondrial regulation of apoptosis.
slots.clarification_sentence: This defined a transition in B cell survival mechanisms.

slots.claim_sentence: Uninfected B cells relied on BCL-2 for survival.
slots.clarification_sentence: Early-infected cells relied on MCL-1/BCL-2, and immortalized cells relied on BFL-1.

slots.claim_sentence: This dynamic change in B cell survival mechanisms is unique to virus-infected cells.
slots.clarification_sentence: It relies on the viral EBNA3A protein.

slots.claim_sentence: EBNA3A regulates MCL-1 mitochondrial localization.
slots.clarification_sentence: It also regulates BFL-1 transcription.

slots.claim_sentence: EBNA3A suppresses apoptosis by promoting MCL-1 mitochondrial localization.
slots.clarification_sentence: EBNA3A also increases BFL-1 mRNA transcription.

slots.claim_sentence: This study defines a new role for EBNA3A in the suppression of apoptosis.
slots.clarification_sentence: This has implications for EBV lymphomagenesis.

slots.clarification_sentence: This adaptation helps prevent self-fertilization.

slots.clarification_sentence: The S-locus supergene determines the arrangement of reproductive organs.

slots.clarification_sentence: The G locus determines the style-length dimorphism in primroses.

slots.claim_sentence: The CYP734A50 gene encodes a putative brassinosteroid-degrading enzyme.
slots.clarification_sentence: Brassinosteroids are plant hormones that promote growth.

slots.claim_sentence: The CYP734A50 gene is only present on the short-styled S-morph haplotype.
slots.clarification_sentence: This gene is specifically expressed in S-morph styles.

slots.claim_sentence: Loss or inactivation of CYP734A50 leads to long styles.
slots.clarification_sentence: The gene's presence ensures short styles.

slots.claim_sentence: The CYP734A50 gene arose by a duplication specific to the Primulaceae lineage.
slots.clarification_sentence: The gene shows an accelerated rate of molecular evolution.

slots.claim_sentence: These results provide a mechanistic explanation for the Primula style-length dimorphism.
slots.clarification_sentence: The findings shed light on the evolution of the S-locus.

Cell differentiation depends on external cues.
Differentiation also depends on morphogenetic events.
slots.clarification_sentence: Morphogenetic events control how receptive cells are to differentiation cues.

slots.claim_sentence: BMP is a key pluripotency signal.
slots.clarification_sentence: BMP feeds into this control mechanism.

slots.claim_sentence: BMP primes pluripotent cells for mesoderm differentiation.

slots.claim_sentence: The two centrioles of the centrosome in quiescent cells are asymmetric structures.
slots.clarification_sentence: These centrioles differ in age, morphology, and function.

slots.claim_sentence: It is unknown how these asymmetric properties are established and maintained during quiescence.
This study shows that Cep120 plays a critical inhibitory role at daughter centrioles.
slots.clarification_sentence: Cep120 is a ciliopathy protein associated with daughter centrioles.

slots.claim_sentence: Depletion of Cep120 in quiescent mouse and human cells causes accumulation of pericentriolar material (PCM) components.
slots.clarification_sentence: These components include pericentrin, Cdk5Rap2, ninein, and Cep170.

slots.claim_sentence: The elevated PCM levels result in increased microtubule-nucleation activity at the centrosome.
slots.clarification_sentence: The centrosome initiates the formation of new microtubules.

slots.claim_sentence: Loss of Cep120 leads to aberrant dynein-dependent trafficking of centrosomal proteins.
slots.clarification_sentence: It also causes dispersal of centriolar satellites and defective ciliary assembly and signaling.

slots.claim_sentence: Cep120 is preferentially enriched on daughter centrioles.
Cep120 helps maintain centrosome homeostasis by inhibiting untimely maturation of the daughter centriole.
The findings define a potentially new molecular defect underlying the pathogenesis of ciliopathies.
slots.clarification_sentence: These ciliopathies include Jeune Asphyxiating Thoracic Dystrophy and Joubert syndrome.

slots.claim_sentence: Neuron-glia interactions are crucial for the maturation of neural circuits.
slots.clarification_sentence: However, the communication pathways in the developing central nervous system (CNS) are not well understood.

slots.claim_sentence: This study investigated neuron-glia signaling in the developing retina.
slots.clarification_sentence: Retinal waves reliably induce calcium transients in Müller glial cells (MCs).

slots.claim_sentence: During cholinergic waves, muscarinic acetylcholine receptor antagonists blocked MC calcium transients.
slots.clarification_sentence: During glutamatergic waves, ionotropic glutamate receptor antagonists inhibited MC calcium transients.

slots.claim_sentence: This shows that MC responsiveness changes to match the neurotransmitter used for retinal waves.
slots.clarification_sentence: Müller glial cell responsiveness adapts to the specific neurotransmitter involved.

slots.claim_sentence: An optical glutamate sensor revealed a decline in MC calcium transients.
slots.clarification_sentence: This decline is caused by a reduction in the amount of glutamate reaching the MCs.

slots.claim_sentence: Neurons and MCs exhibit correlated activity during a critical period of retinal maturation.
slots.clarification_sentence: Neurotransmitter spillover from retinal synapses enables this correlated activity.

slots.claim_sentence: Establishing the time since death, known as the postmortem interval (PMI), is crucial in every death investigation.
slots.clarification_sentence: However, current methods for determining PMI have errors and biases.

slots.claim_sentence: For example, forensic entomology is a common method to assess PMI.
slots.clarification_sentence: This method can have significant errors, sometimes ranging from days to months.

slots.claim_sentence: Microbes could offer a new method for estimating the postmortem interval.
slots.clarification_sentence: This microbial method may overcome many limitations of current techniques.

slots.claim_sentence: This study showed that postmortem microbial community changes are dramatic and measurable.
slots.clarification_sentence: These changes are also repeatable in a mouse model system.

slots.claim_sentence: The changes allowed PMI to be estimated within approximately 3 days.
slots.clarification_sentence: This estimation was possible over a 48-day period in the mouse model.

slots.claim_sentence: The findings provide a detailed understanding of bacterial and microbial eukaryotic ecology.
slots.clarification_sentence: This ecology occurs within a decomposing corpse system.

slots.claim_sentence: Microbial community data could be developed into a forensic tool.
slots.clarification_sentence: This tool would be used for estimating PMI.

slots.clarification_sentence: AMPARs do not accumulate in extrasynaptic membranes.

slots.claim_sentence: This contradicts the hypothesis that AMPAR entry is limited by the occupancy of open PSD 'slots'.
slots.clarification_sentence: AMPAR entry is not regulated by a limited number of 'slots'.

slots.claim_sentence: The mechanism for the earliest response of central neurons to hypoxia was previously unknown.
slots.clarification_sentence: This response is an increase in voltage-gated sodium current, called INa.

slots.claim_sentence: Hypoxia activates the Small Ubiquitin-like Modifier (SUMO) pathway in rat cerebellar granule neurons (CGN).
slots.clarification_sentence: Neurons in the brain require a continuous supply of oxygen for normal activity.

slots.claim_sentence: SUMOylation of NaV1.2 channels increases the voltage-gated sodium current (INa).
slots.clarification_sentence: SUMOylation is the process of attaching SUMO proteins to other proteins.

slots.claim_sentence: SUMOylation of NaV1.2 channels and the increase in INa are both prevented by specific actions.
slots.clarification_sentence: These actions include mutation of NaV1.2-Lys38 or application of a deSUMOylating enzyme.

slots.claim_sentence: Within 40 seconds, hypoxia-induced linkage of SUMO1 to the channels is complete.
slots.clarification_sentence: This linkage shifts the voltage-dependence of channel activation, leading to larger sodium currents.

slots.claim_sentence: The time-course for SUMOylation of single NaV1.2 channels and changes in INa coincide.
The SUMO pathway and NaV1.2 are potential targets for neuroprotective interventions.
slots.clarification_sentence: This is due to the recognized role of INa in hypoxic brain damage.

slots.claim_sentence: Vector-borne disease transmission peaks at intermediate temperatures.
slots.clarification_sentence: Transmission declines at high and low temperatures.

slots.claim_sentence: However, the thermal optima and limits for most vector-borne pathogens are unknown.
Researchers developed a mechanistic model for the thermal response of Ross River virus.
slots.clarification_sentence: Ross River virus is an important mosquito-borne pathogen in Australia and the Pacific Islands.

slots.claim_sentence: The model showed that Ross River virus transmission peaks at 26.4°C.
slots.clarification_sentence: This is considered a moderate temperature.

slots.claim_sentence: Transmission declines to zero at thermal limits of 17.0°C and 31.5°C.
The model predicts year-round Ross River virus transmission in tropical areas.
slots.clarification_sentence: It also predicts seasonal transmission in temperate areas, leading to a nationwide peak in human cases.

slots.claim_sentence: Climate warming will likely increase transmission in temperate areas.
slots.clarification_sentence: Most Australians live in these temperate areas, but warming will decrease transmission in tropical areas.

slots.claim_sentence: These results highlight the importance of nonlinear models.
slots.clarification_sentence: Nonlinear models help predict responses to climate change and understand temperature's role in disease dynamics.

slots.claim_sentence: The behavioral correlates of motor cortical beta oscillations are not fully understood.
slots.clarification_sentence: Motor cortical beta oscillations are a type of brain wave in the motor system that controls movement.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers recorded multi-scale neural activity from the motor cortex of three macaques.
slots.clarification_sentence: This was done to investigate the link between population neural activity, beta oscillations, and behavior using a neurofeedback task.

slots.claim_sentence: The macaques intentionally increased or decreased their beta oscillatory power to a specific level.
slots.clarification_sentence: After controlling their beta power, the macaques then performed an arm reach.

slots.claim_sentence: Arm reaches were initiated significantly faster when beta power was previously reduced.
slots.clarification_sentence: Movement onset times were slower when beta power had been increased.

slots.claim_sentence: Population neural activity shifted farther from a movement onset state during beta oscillations.
slots.clarification_sentence: This shift occurred whether beta oscillations were induced by neurofeedback or happened naturally. A movement onset state refers to specific neural activity patterns before movement begins.

slots.claim_sentence: When neurons generated beta oscillations, their patterns were further from the movement onset threshold.
This research provides a neural explanation for slower movement initiation.
slots.clarification_sentence: This explanation is at the population level and follows periods of beta oscillatory activity.

slots.claim_sentence: TRAF2 is a component of TNF superfamily signaling complexes.
slots.clarification_sentence: It plays an essential role in the regulation and homeostasis of immune cells.

slots.claim_sentence: TRAF2 deficient mice die around birth.
slots.clarification_sentence: This limits exploration of TRAF2's role in adult tissues.

slots.claim_sentence: The role of the TRAF2 RING domain is controversial.
slots.clarification_sentence: The TRAF2 RING domain's function, particularly its E3 ligase activity, has been debated.

slots.claim_sentence: Some claim the atypical TRAF2 RING cannot function as a ubiquitin E3 ligase.
slots.clarification_sentence: Others claim it requires sphingosine-1-phosphate (S1P) as a co-factor.

slots.claim_sentence: S1P is generated by sphingosine kinase 1 (SPHK1).
Keratinocyte-specific deletion of Traf2 disrupted TNF-mediated NF-κB and MAP kinase signaling.
slots.clarification_sentence: This deletion caused epidermal hyperplasia and psoriatic skin inflammation.

slots.claim_sentence: Sphk1 deficiency did not cause these effects.
slots.clarification_sentence: TRAF2 protects keratinocytes from cell death.

slots.claim_sentence: The inflammation was driven by TNF, cell death, and non-canonical NF-κB.
slots.clarification_sentence: The adaptive immune system also drove the inflammation.

slots.claim_sentence: This might represent a clinically relevant model of psoriasis.
TRAF2 has essential tissue-specific functions.
slots.clarification_sentence: These functions do not overlap with those of Sphk1.

slots.claim_sentence: Glucocorticoids are commonly prescribed drugs.
slots.clarification_sentence: However, there is no biomarker to quantify their action.

slots.claim_sentence: This study aimed to identify and validate circulating biomarkers of glucocorticoid action.
The discovery study included 10 subjects with primary adrenal insufficiency.
slots.clarification_sentence: These subjects were studied during glucocorticoid exposure and withdrawal. Primary adrenal insufficiency is a unique model for biomarker discovery.

slots.claim_sentence: Integrated multi-omic analysis was used to compare different types of biological data.
slots.clarification_sentence: This analysis included transcriptome in peripheral blood mononuclear cells and adipose tissue, plasma miRNAomic, and serum metabolomics.

slots.claim_sentence: The study identified a transcriptomic profile from two tissues.
slots.clarification_sentence: A multi-omic cluster was also identified; both were predictive of glucocorticoid exposure.

slots.claim_sentence: A microRNA called miR-122-5p was identified.
slots.clarification_sentence: This microRNA correlated with genes and metabolites regulated by glucocorticoid exposure. This suggests a functional role in glucocorticoid action.

slots.claim_sentence: The identified microRNA, miR-122-5p, was replicated in independent studies.
slots.clarification_sentence: These studies involved varying glucocorticoid exposure. Replication increases the likelihood of miR-122-5p becoming a biomarker.

slots.claim_sentence: These results provide a basis for discovering biomarkers to measure glucocorticoid effects.
slots.clarification_sentence: This could allow strategies to individualize and optimize glucocorticoid therapy and shed light on disease etiology.

slots.claim_sentence: Dendritic cells take up antigens, and C-type lectin receptors regulate their intracellular routing.
slots.clarification_sentence: These receptors recognize glycan structures on the antigens.

slots.claim_sentence: Modifying Ovalbumin (OVA) with the glycan structure LewisX (LeX) redirects OVA to the C-type lectin receptor MGL1.
LeX-modification of OVA favored Th1 skewing of CD4+ T cells.
slots.clarification_sentence: It also enhanced cross-priming of CD8+ T cells.

slots.claim_sentence: Native OVA requires a high antigen dose and TLR stimuli for cross-presentation.
slots.clarification_sentence: LeX modification reduces the required OVA amount 100-fold and removes its dependence on TLR signaling.

slots.claim_sentence: The OVA-LeX-induced enhancement of T cell cross-priming is MGL1-dependent.
slots.clarification_sentence: MGL1-deficient mice showed reduced CD8+ effector T cell frequencies.

slots.claim_sentence: MGL1-mediated cross-presentation of OVA-LeX did not require TAP-transporters or Cathepsin-S.
slots.clarification_sentence: This process occurred even after prolonged intracellular storage in Rab11+LAMP1+ compartments.

slots.claim_sentence: Cross-presentation was associated with prolonged intracellular storage of antigen in Rab11+LAMP1+ vesicles.
Controlled neo-glycosylation of antigens can influence their intracellular routing.
slots.clarification_sentence: This approach should be considered for optimizing vaccination strategies.

slots.claim_sentence: Burkholderia thailandensis uses acyl-homoserine lactone-mediated quorum sensing systems.
slots.clarification_sentence: These systems regulate hundreds of genes in the bacteria.

slots.claim_sentence: Quorum sensing in B. thailandensis activates cell-cell contact-dependent type VI secretion (T6S) systems.
slots.clarification_sentence: These T6S systems include toxin-immunity components.

slots.claim_sentence: Type VI secretion (T6S) is required to constrain quorum sensing mutants.
slots.clarification_sentence: This constraint occurs in colony cocultures of a BtaR1 mutant and its parent.

slots.claim_sentence: The BtaR1 mutant outcompetes its parent in broth coculture.
slots.clarification_sentence: This happens because cell contact is limited and quorum sensing has a metabolic cost.

slots.claim_sentence: Quorum sensing activates B. thailandensis T6SS-1 growth inhibition.
slots.clarification_sentence: This control polices and constrains quorum-sensing mutants.

slots.claim_sentence: This work defines a novel role for Type VI secretion systems (T6SSs).
slots.clarification_sentence: This role involves intraspecies mutant control.

slots.claim_sentence: T6S provides wild-type B. thailandensis with an ability to constrain BtaR1 mutants.
slots.clarification_sentence: This ability is contact-dependent.

slots.claim_sentence: Quorum sensing control of T6SS-1-mediated toxicity allows policing against BtaR1-QS mutants.

slots.claim_sentence: Epsin is an evolutionarily conserved clathrin adaptor protein involved in endocytosis.
slots.clarification_sentence: Its most critical functions in clathrin coat dynamics are not fully understood.

slots.claim_sentence: To understand epsin's functions, researchers created embryonic fibroblasts from mice.

slots.clarification_sentence: The absence of epsin impacted cytokinesis profiles.

slots.claim_sentence: These cells also exhibited a robust impairment in clathrin-mediated endocytosis.
slots.clarification_sentence: This impairment was characterized by an accumulation of early and U-shaped pits.

slots.claim_sentence: The impairment in endocytosis was linked to a disruption in the connection between the clathrin coat and the actin cytoskeleton.
slots.clarification_sentence: This finding was confirmed by a cell-free assay.

slots.claim_sentence: A key evolutionary conserved function of epsin is to help generate the force for the invagination and fission of clathrin-coated pits.
slots.clarification_sentence: Epsin also has a low-affinity interaction with SNAREs.

slots.claim_sentence: Clathrin-coated pit dynamics were also altered in epsin triple knockout cells.
slots.clarification_sentence: The turnover rate of pits was much lower in these cells.

slots.claim_sentence: Interactions between three pigment cell types are necessary to form the stripe pattern of adult zebrafish.
Mutations in the leopard (leo) gene cause spotted patterns in zebrafish.
slots.clarification_sentence: The leo gene encodes Connexin 41.8 (Cx41.8), a gap junction subunit.

slots.claim_sentence: A new dominant allele, leotK3, causes a complete loss of the stripe pattern in zebrafish.
slots.clarification_sentence: This suggests a dominant negative impact on another component of gap junctions.

slots.claim_sentence: A genetic screen identified Connexin 39.4 (Cx39.4), also known as luchs, as a component of gap junctions.

slots.clarification_sentence: However, the fins are almost not affected by these luchs alleles.

slots.claim_sentence: Both connexins, Cx41.8 (leo) and Cx39.4 (luchs), form heteromeric gap junctions.
slots.clarification_sentence: These gap junctions are required in xanthophores and melanophores, but not in iridophores.

slots.claim_sentence: These heteromeric gap junctions promote homotypic interactions between melanophores and xanthophores.
slots.clarification_sentence: These cells then instruct the patterning of the iridophores.

slots.claim_sentence: Cx41.8 and Cx39.4 form heteromeric gap junction channels in melanophores and xanthophores.

slots.claim_sentence: The global malaria burden has decreased over the last decade.
slots.clarification_sentence: Many nations are attempting to eliminate malaria.

slots.claim_sentence: Asymptomatic malaria infections are not normally diagnosed or treated.
slots.clarification_sentence: This poses a major hurdle for malaria elimination efforts.

slots.claim_sentence: Mass drug administration (MDA) is one solution to address asymptomatic malaria infections.
slots.clarification_sentence: The success of MDA depends on adequate population participation.

slots.claim_sentence: This study conducted a detailed spatial and temporal analysis of malaria episodes.
slots.clarification_sentence: The analysis included asymptomatic infections in four villages in Myanmar undergoing MDA.

slots.claim_sentence: Individuals in neighborhoods with low MDA adherence had 2.85 times higher odds of a malaria episode.
slots.clarification_sentence: This was compared to those in high adherence neighborhoods, regardless of individual participation.

slots.claim_sentence: This finding suggests a herd effect.
slots.clarification_sentence: This study is the first to document a herd effect from MDA for Plasmodium falciparum malaria.

slots.claim_sentence: High mosquito biting rates were predictors of clinical malaria episodes.
slots.clarification_sentence: Living with someone else with malaria or having an asymptomatic infection were also predictors.

slots.claim_sentence: The herd effect means that high community-level participation in MDA provides protection.
slots.clarification_sentence: This protection extends even to individuals who did not personally adhere to the drug administration.

slots.claim_sentence: Spatial clustering of non-adherence to MDA may hinder malaria elimination efforts.
slots.clarification_sentence: This can occur even in villages with high overall participation.

slots.claim_sentence: The developing heart and lung engage in extensive crosstalk.
slots.clarification_sentence: This interaction is crucial for their proper formation and maturation.

slots.claim_sentence: However, there is a lack of models to investigate this critical cardio-pulmonary interaction.
slots.clarification_sentence: This gap exists for human embryogenesis.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers developed a novel stepwise strategy.
slots.clarification_sentence: This strategy simultaneously induced cardiac and lung epithelial lineages from human-induced pluripotent stem cells (hiPSCs).

slots.claim_sentence: The induction used temporal tuning of WNT and nodal signaling.
slots.clarification_sentence: This was done without exogenous growth factors.

slots.claim_sentence: The strategy directed both mesoderm-derived cardiac and endoderm-derived lung epithelial lineages.
Using 3D suspension culture, concentric cardio-pulmonary micro-Tissues (μTs) were established.
slots.clarification_sentence: Alveolar maturation was expedited in the presence of cardiac accompaniment.

slots.claim_sentence: Upon withdrawal of a WNT agonist, the cardiac and pulmonary components segregated.
slots.clarification_sentence: This occurred within each dual-lineage micro-Tissue, with concurrent initiation of cardiac contraction.

slots.claim_sentence: The accompanying cardiac lineage served as an essential cellular niche.
slots.clarification_sentence: This niche promoted effective alveolar maturation.

slots.claim_sentence: This multilineage differentiation model offers an experimentally tractable system.
slots.clarification_sentence: It can investigate human cardio-pulmonary interaction and tissue boundary formation during embryogenesis.

slots.claim_sentence: Most changes in an organism's DNA negatively impact fitness.
slots.clarification_sentence: However, specific mutations allow organisms to adapt to stressful environments.

slots.claim_sentence: The mutation rate is strictly regulated.
slots.clarification_sentence: It is often considered a slowly-evolving parameter.

slots.claim_sentence: This study demonstrates an unexpected flexibility in cellular mutation rates.
slots.clarification_sentence: These rates respond to changes in selective pressure.

slots.clarification_sentence: Hypermutation means cells accumulate mutations more quickly.

slots.claim_sentence: Hypermutator states are transitory.
slots.clarification_sentence: They repeatedly alternate with decreases in mutation rate.

slots.claim_sentence: Population mutation rates rise when cells experience higher stress.
slots.clarification_sentence: The rates decline again once cells are adapted.

slots.claim_sentence: Cellular mortality is the major force driving the quick evolution of mutation rates.
slots.clarification_sentence: Cellular mortality modulates the population mutation rate.

slots.claim_sentence: Cellular mortality is a major modulator of the population mutation rate.
These findings show how organisms balance robustness and evolvability.
slots.clarification_sentence: They help explain hypermutation in antibiotic resistance and cancer relapses upon chemotherapy.

slots.claim_sentence: The transcription factor RpaA is the master regulator of circadian transcription in cyanobacteria.

slots.claim_sentence: Reconstruction of carbon utilization pathways restores viability of the rpaA- strain.
slots.clarification_sentence: Providing an external carbon source also helps restore viability in light/dark cycling conditions.

slots.claim_sentence: Reconstruction of carbon utilization pathways combined with an external carbon source restores energy charge.

slots.claim_sentence: Ring-forming AAA+ chaperones use ATP to unfold substrates.
slots.clarification_sentence: They thread substrates through a central pore.

slots.claim_sentence: The unfolding activity of AAA+ chaperones can be harmful.
slots.clarification_sentence: This activity requires tight repression and substrate-specific activation mechanisms.

slots.claim_sentence: The AAA+ chaperone ClpC combines with the peptidase ClpP.
slots.clarification_sentence: This combination forms a bacterial protease essential for virulence and stress resistance.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers studied how ClpC is repressed in its ground state.
slots.clarification_sentence: They determined ClpC cryo-EM structures with and without MecA.

slots.claim_sentence: In its repressed state, ClpC forms large two-helical assemblies.
slots.clarification_sentence: These assemblies associate via head-to-head contacts between coiled-coil middle domains (MDs).

slots.claim_sentence: MecA converts the resting state of ClpC to an active planar ring structure.
slots.clarification_sentence: MecA binds to the middle domain (MD) interaction sites.

slots.claim_sentence: Loss of ClpC repression in middle domain (MD) mutants causes constitutive activation.
slots.clarification_sentence: This leads to severe cellular toxicity.

slots.claim_sentence: These findings reveal an unexpected regulatory concept.
slots.clarification_sentence: Coiled-coil middle domains (MDs) tightly control AAA+ chaperone activity.

slots.claim_sentence: The findings extend the role of coiled-coil MDs as regulatory devices.
slots.clarification_sentence: The coiled-coil MDs control AAA+ protein activity.

slots.claim_sentence: The substantia nigra pars reticulata (SNr) contains spontaneously active GABAergic neurons.
slots.clarification_sentence: These neurons provide tonic inhibition to downstream brain areas within the basal ganglia.

slots.claim_sentence: A depolarizing 'leak' current supports this spontaneous firing pattern.
slots.clarification_sentence: However, the molecular basis of this current is poorly understood.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers used single-cell RNA sequencing to study individual mouse SNr neurons.
slots.clarification_sentence: This method helped determine the transcriptome of these neurons to understand their tonic activity.

slots.claim_sentence: SNr neurons express the sodium leak channel, NALCN.
slots.clarification_sentence: SNr neurons that lacked NALCN had impaired spontaneous firing.

slots.claim_sentence: NALCN is involved in modulating SNr neuron excitability.
slots.clarification_sentence: This modulation occurs due to changes in glycolysis and activation of muscarinic acetylcholine receptors.

slots.claim_sentence: NALCN is important for the regulation of SNr neuron excitability by muscarinic acetylcholine receptor activation.
slots.clarification_sentence: NALCN helps SNr neurons adjust their activity in response to metabolic changes.

slots.claim_sentence: Disruption of NALCN could impair the basal ganglia circuit.
slots.clarification_sentence: This impairment may explain severe motor deficits in humans with NALCN mutations.

slots.claim_sentence: Tuberculous meningitis has high mortality.
slots.clarification_sentence: This condition is linked to excessive inflammation.

slots.claim_sentence: Adjunctive anti-inflammatory corticosteroids reduce mortality by only 30%.
slots.clarification_sentence: This suggests that inflammatory pathophysiology causes only a subset of deaths.

slots.claim_sentence: In Vietnam, corticosteroids helped patients with a C/T promoter variant in the LTA4H gene.
slots.clarification_sentence: The leukotriene A4 hydrolase (LTA4H) gene encodes an enzyme that regulates inflammation.

slots.claim_sentence: LTA4H TT patients with increased gene expression had increased survival.
slots.clarification_sentence: This finding is consistent with corticosteroids benefiting individuals with hyper-inflammatory responses.

slots.claim_sentence: An Indonesia study did not find an LTA4H TT genotype survival benefit.
Researchers used Bayesian methods to analyze both studies.
slots.clarification_sentence: The LTA4H TT genotype confers survival benefit that begins early and continues long-term in both populations.

slots.claim_sentence: This benefit is nullified in the most severe cases.
slots.clarification_sentence: These cases have high early mortality.

slots.claim_sentence: The Bayesian analysis resolved the discrepancy between the two studies.
LTA4H genotyping and disease severity assessment may target glucocorticoid therapy.
slots.clarification_sentence: This approach could help patients most likely to benefit from the treatment.

slots.claim_sentence: The roles of chance, contingency, and necessity in evolution are unresolved.

slots.claim_sentence: Contingency generated over long historical timescales erased necessity.
slots.clarification_sentence: Contingency also overwhelmed chance as the primary cause of acquired sequence variation.

slots.claim_sentence: Patterns of variation in BCL-2 sequences are idiosyncratic products.
slots.clarification_sentence: These products result from a particular and unpredictable course of historical events.

slots.clarification_sentence: However, chromosome segregation remained robust.

slots.claim_sentence: A framework was explored to model the dose response of allosteric multisite phosphorylation proteins.
slots.clarification_sentence: This framework uses a single auxiliary variable.

slots.claim_sentence: This modeling framework can replicate the steady state behavior of detailed multisite systems.
slots.clarification_sentence: Examples include the Monod-Wyman-Changeux allosteric model and rule-based models.

slots.claim_sentence: Optimal ultrasensitivity in allosteric proteins is achieved when activation by individual sites is concerted and redundant.
slots.clarification_sentence: Multiple phosphorylations are necessary for activation, but not all sites need full phosphorylation.

slots.claim_sentence: The reduction in complexity makes this framework useful for modeling biochemical systems.
slots.clarification_sentence: It is useful in practical applications where several multisite proteins interact simultaneously.

slots.claim_sentence: As an application, the study analyzes a checkpoint signaling pathway in budding yeast.
slots.clarification_sentence: This pathway measures cell growth by monitoring signals from plasma membrane growth.

slots.claim_sentence: The known components of this pathway in budding yeast can form a robust hysteretic switch.
slots.clarification_sentence: A hysteretic switch maintains a high output even if the input signal decreases.

slots.claim_sentence: The system incorporates a signal proportional to bud growth or size.
slots.clarification_sentence: It also includes a mechanism to read the signal and an all-or-none response triggered when sufficient growth occurs.

slots.claim_sentence: Inflammation is necessary for promoting, sustaining, and tuning CD8+ T cell responses.
The transcription factor IRF-5 mainly induces the inflammatory response following Leishmania donovani infection.
IRF-5 activates genes encoding key pro-inflammatory cytokines like IL-6 and TNF.
The inflammatory response induced by IRF-5 limits CD8+ T cell expansion.
slots.clarification_sentence: This response also induces HIF-1α in dendritic cells.

slots.claim_sentence: Ablation of HIF-1α in CD11c+ cells resulted in a higher frequency of short-lived effector cells (SLEC).
slots.clarification_sentence: This ablation also enhanced CD8+ T cell expansion and increased IL-12 expression by splenic DCs.

slots.claim_sentence: Mice with targeted depletion of HIF-1α in CD11c+ cells had a significantly lower splenic parasite burden.
slots.clarification_sentence: This suggests that HIF-1α induction may be an immune evasive mechanism used by Leishmania parasites to establish persistent infections.

slots.claim_sentence: Parasites that cause severe malaria appear to increase expression of a restricted subset of PfEMP1 surface antigens.
slots.clarification_sentence: PfEMP1 proteins are major targets of the immune system.

slots.claim_sentence: The study used RNA sequencing to analyze gene expression in 44 parasite isolates.
slots.clarification_sentence: These isolates were from Papuan patients with severe and uncomplicated malaria.

slots.claim_sentence: Transcriptomes of 19 parasite isolates with severe malaria showed decreased glycolysis.
slots.clarification_sentence: This decrease occurred without activation of compensatory pathways. Glycolysis is a fundamental metabolic process for energy generation.

slots.claim_sentence: Parasites with severe malaria also had altered chromatin structure.
slots.clarification_sentence: This was likely due to decreased histone methylation, affecting gene regulation. Chromatin structure and histone methylation regulate gene expression.

slots.claim_sentence: These parasites showed reduced surface expression of PfEMP1.
slots.clarification_sentence: They also had down-regulated expression of multiple chaperone proteins. Chaperone proteins assist in proper protein folding.

slots.claim_sentence: RNA sequencing identified novel associations between disease severity and PfEMP1 transcripts.
slots.clarification_sentence: These associations included PfEMP1 domains and smaller sequence segments.

slots.claim_sentence: The RNA sequencing study confirmed all previously reported associations.
slots.clarification_sentence: These were between expressed PfEMP1 sequences and severe disease. Confirming previous findings strengthens reliability.

slots.claim_sentence: These findings will inform efforts to identify vaccine targets for severe malaria.
slots.clarification_sentence: Identifying specific parasite proteins can help develop effective vaccines.

slots.claim_sentence: Long-term delivery of potent broadly-neutralizing antibodies is a promising approach for preventing HIV-1 infection.
Researchers used an AAV vector to deliver anti-SIV monoclonal antibodies (mAbs) in IgG1 form to rhesus monkeys.
slots.clarification_sentence: The AAV vector was delivered intramuscularly.

slots.claim_sentence: Persisting levels of delivered monoclonal antibody (mAb) as high as 270 μg/ml were achieved in rhesus monkeys.
Host antibody responses to the delivered antibody were observed in 9 of 12 rhesus monkeys.
slots.clarification_sentence: These responses appeared to limit the concentration of delivered antibody.

slots.claim_sentence: Six monkeys in the AAV-5L7 IgG1 mAb group showed clear protective effects against SIVmac239 challenge.
slots.clarification_sentence: This occurred despite the absence of detectable neutralizing activity against the virus.

slots.claim_sentence: The protective effects included lowering of viral load at peak height and at set point.
slots.clarification_sentence: There was also a delay in the time to peak viral load.

slots.claim_sentence: The monkey with the highest level of delivered 5L7 mAb completely resisted six successive SIVmac239 intravenous challenges.
The results demonstrate the continued promise of the AAV-mediated antibody delivery approach for preventing HIV-1 infection in people.
The problem of anti-antibody responses will need to be understood and overcome.
slots.clarification_sentence: This is necessary for the approach to be effectively realized.

slots.claim_sentence: Toxoplasma is an obligate intracellular parasite that replicates within a parasitophorous vacuole (PV) in mammalian cells.
slots.clarification_sentence: The PV does not fuse with any host organelles.

slots.claim_sentence: This study examined how Toxoplasma exploits host lipid droplets (LD).
slots.clarification_sentence: Lipid droplets are fat storage organelles.

slots.claim_sentence: Toxoplasma replication is reduced in host cells depleted of lipid droplets.
slots.clarification_sentence: Replication is also reduced with impaired triacylglycerol (TAG) lipolysis or fatty acid catabolism.

slots.claim_sentence: Throughout Toxoplasma infection, the parasitophorous vacuole is surrounded by host lipid droplets.
Toxoplasma can access lipids stored in host lipid droplets.
slots.clarification_sentence: The parasite incorporates these lipids into its own membranes and lipid droplets.

slots.claim_sentence: Toxoplasma intercepts and internalizes host lipid droplets within the PV to access their lipids.
slots.clarification_sentence: These host LD become wrapped by an intravacuolar network of membranes (IVN).

slots.claim_sentence: Mutant parasites with impaired IVN formation show reduced lipid uptake from host lipid droplets.
Parasites lacking an IVN-localized phospholipase A2 are less efficient at salvaging lipids from host LD in the PV.
This study highlights Toxoplasma's reliance on host lipid droplets for its intracellular development.
slots.clarification_sentence: The parasite is capable of scavenging neutral lipids from host LD.

slots.claim_sentence: Fasciolosis is an emerging zoonotic disease caused by liver flukes Fasciola hepatica and Fasciola gigantica.
slots.clarification_sentence: This disease is considered emerging due to increased reports of human infections.

slots.claim_sentence: Resistance to triclabendazole, a main drug for fasciolosis, necessitates new treatments.
slots.clarification_sentence: New chemical entities and target molecules are needed to control fluke infections.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers screened forty flavonoid derivatives for inhibitors of Fasciola hepatica cysteine proteases.
slots.clarification_sentence: The proteases studied were FhCL3 and FhCL1, which are stage-specific enzymes.

slots.claim_sentence: Chalcones with phenyl and naphthyl groups were identified as good cathepsin L inhibitors.
slots.clarification_sentence: These chalcones interacted with two binding sites within the active site cleft of the enzymes.

slots.claim_sentence: One compound, C34, tightly bound to juvenile-specific FhCL3.
slots.clarification_sentence: C34 showed an IC50 of 5.6 μM against the enzyme.

slots.claim_sentence: C34 is a slow-reversible inhibitor that interacts with the Cys-His catalytic dyad of FhCL3.
slots.clarification_sentence: C34 also interacts with key S2 and S3 pocket residues, which determine substrate specificity.

slots.claim_sentence: C34 reduced the ability of NEJ to migrate through the gut wall and caused a loss of motility.
slots.clarification_sentence: This led to NEJ death within a week in vitro, and C34 was not cytotoxic to bovine cells.

slots.claim_sentence: These findings open new avenues for developing novel agents to control fluke infection.
slots.clarification_sentence: The agents could also potentially control other helminthic diseases.

slots.claim_sentence: The visual system transmits information about fast and slow changes in light intensity through separate neural pathways.
The study investigated how bipolar cells transmit visual signals to the inner retina.
slots.clarification_sentence: Researchers used in vivo imaging for this investigation.

slots.claim_sentence: The volume of the synaptic terminal is an intrinsic property that contributes to different temporal filters.
slots.clarification_sentence: The geometry of the synaptic compartment influences how bipolar cells transmit diverse signals.

slots.claim_sentence: Smaller synaptic terminals generate faster and larger calcium transients to trigger vesicle release.
slots.clarification_sentence: This process leads to higher initial gain and more profound adaptation.

slots.claim_sentence: Smaller synaptic terminals transmit higher stimulus frequencies more effectively.
slots.clarification_sentence: Smaller terminals transmit frequencies between 5 and 10 Hz significantly better.

slots.claim_sentence: Modeling global calcium dynamics indicated that variations in presynaptic compartment volume directly contribute to response differences.
slots.clarification_sentence: Terminal volume influences the amplitude and kinetics of the presynaptic calcium signal.

slots.claim_sentence: One neuron can transmit different temporal components in the visual signal.
slots.clarification_sentence: This occurs through synaptic terminals of varying geometries with different adaptational properties.

slots.claim_sentence: The impact of Nrf2 activation on human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) infection had not been tested.
Sulforaphane (SFN) is found in cruciferous vegetables.
slots.clarification_sentence: SFN mobilizes Nrf2 to reprogram cellular gene expression. SFN is a powerful mobilizer of the transcription factor Nrf2.

slots.claim_sentence: SFN blocks HIV infection in primary macrophages.
slots.clarification_sentence: SFN does not block HIV infection in primary T cells.

slots.claim_sentence: Depletion of Nrf2 boosted HIV infectivity in primary macrophages.
slots.clarification_sentence: This depletion reduced the anti-viral effects of SFN treatment. Nrf2 is detrimental to HIV infection in macrophages.

slots.claim_sentence: The anti-viral activity of SFN against HIV is mediated through Nrf2.
slots.clarification_sentence: Nrf2 is mobilized by SFN. SFN acts to block HIV by increasing Nrf2 levels.

slots.claim_sentence: SFN treatment blocks HIV infection after entry.
slots.clarification_sentence: This block occurs before the formation of 2-LTR circles. SFN stops HIV infection after reverse transcription.

slots.claim_sentence: Neither SAMHD1 nor MX2 were upregulated by SFN treatment.
slots.clarification_sentence: SFN did not significantly change levels of either SAMHD1 or MX2.

slots.claim_sentence: Nrf2 action can potently block HIV infection.
slots.clarification_sentence: This study highlights a novel way to trigger this inhibition. SFN provides a new way to activate an anti-viral state.

slots.clarification_sentence: The mutant parasites were viable.

slots.claim_sentence: ΔNCR1 mutant Toxoplasma generated multiple daughters per single mother cell at high frequencies, allowing fast replication in vitro.

slots.claim_sentence: The data suggest that the ΔNCR1 strain lost the ability to control intracellular levels of several lipids.
slots.clarification_sentence: This resulted in stimulated lipid storage, membrane biosynthesis, and parasite division.

slots.claim_sentence: The researchers ascribe a role for TgNCR1 in lipid homeostasis in Toxoplasma.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers conducted six controlled growth trials using an interspecific Setaria italica x Setaria viridis recombinant inbred line population.
slots.clarification_sentence: The study assessed how developmental cues, water availability, and planting density influence the genetic architecture of plant height.

slots.claim_sentence: Non-destructive plant height measurements allowed monitoring throughout the plant life cycle.
slots.clarification_sentence: Measurements were taken in both field and controlled environments.

slots.claim_sentence: Plant height in Setaria is reduced under water limitation and high density planting.
slots.clarification_sentence: Plant height is also affected by the growth environment, such as field versus growth chamber.

slots.claim_sentence: Plant height is a heritable, polygenic trait in Setaria.
slots.clarification_sentence: The major genetic loci influencing plant height function independently of the growth environment. The mean heritability of plant height in this population was 0.82.

slots.claim_sentence: The identity and contribution of loci influencing height change dynamically throughout Setaria development.
slots.clarification_sentence: Growth reduction in water-limited environments results from delayed progression through the genetic program for plant height.

slots.claim_sentence: Alleles from the weedy S. viridis parent increase plant height early in the Setaria population.
slots.clarification_sentence: Many small-effect alleles from the domesticated S. italica parent collectively increase height later in development.

slots.claim_sentence: Heterochromatic homology ensures the segregation of achiasmate chromosomes during meiosis I in Drosophila melanogaster females.
slots.clarification_sentence: Achiasmate chromosomes are chromosomes without crossovers.

slots.claim_sentence: The study investigated how heterochromatic threads and other DNA entanglements are resolved before anaphase I.
Knockdown of Topoisomerase II (Top2) by RNAi caused a defect in the separation of heterochromatic regions.
slots.clarification_sentence: This defect occurred after spindle assembly during later stages of meiosis.

slots.claim_sentence: In Top2 RNAi-expressing oocytes, heterochromatic regions of both achiasmate and chiasmate chromosomes failed to separate.
slots.clarification_sentence: This failure occurred during prometaphase I and metaphase I.

slots.claim_sentence: Heterochromatic regions stretched into long, abnormal projections in some oocytes.
slots.clarification_sentence: Centromeres localized near the tips of these projections.

slots.claim_sentence: Most Top2 RNAi-expressing oocytes had bipolar spindles.
slots.clarification_sentence: However, 4th chromosomes failed to move toward spindle poles during prometaphase I.

slots.claim_sentence: Both achiasmate and chiasmate chromosomes showed defects in biorientation.
slots.clarification_sentence: Biorientation is the proper attachment of sister kinetochores to microtubules from opposite spindle poles.

slots.claim_sentence: Embryos from Top2 RNAi-expressing females often failed to initiate mitotic divisions.
Topoisomerase II is involved in resolving heterochromatic DNA entanglements during meiosis I.
slots.clarification_sentence: These entanglements must be resolved to complete meiosis.

slots.claim_sentence: Dengue virus NS5 is the most highly conserved non-structural protein among flaviviruses.
slots.clarification_sentence: NS5 is responsible for capping, methylation, and replication of the flavivirus RNA genome.

slots.claim_sentence: Dengue virus 2 (DENV2) NS5 localizes to the nucleus during infection.
slots.clarification_sentence: This is an unusual characteristic with no clear role in replication or pathogenesis.

slots.claim_sentence: The C-terminal 18 residues (Cter18) of Dengue virus NS5 alone direct the protein to the cytoplasm or nucleus.
slots.clarification_sentence: This region determines the protein's subcellular location.

slots.claim_sentence: The molecular complex of NS5 Cter18 and importin-alpha (Impα) was purified and crystallized.
slots.clarification_sentence: This complex was visualized at 2.2 Å resolution using x-ray crystallography.

slots.claim_sentence: Mutating Pro-884 to Threonine in DENV2 NS5 mislocalizes NS5 to the cytoplasm.
slots.clarification_sentence: This change does not compromise virus fitness.

slots.claim_sentence: A single mutation to alanine at NS5 position R888 resulted in a completely non-viable virus.
slots.clarification_sentence: R888 is a residue conserved in all flaviviruses.

slots.claim_sentence: R888 forms a hydrogen bond with Y838.
slots.clarification_sentence: Both R888 and Y838 are conserved in all flaviviruses.

slots.claim_sentence: The data suggest an evolutionarily conserved function for NS5 Cter18.
slots.clarification_sentence: This function is possibly in RNA interactions critical for replication, independent of subcellular localization.

slots.claim_sentence: Many countries where neglected tropical diseases (NTDs) are common cannot start or expand programs.
slots.clarification_sentence: These countries lack basic data for planning and advocacy.

slots.claim_sentence: An integrated mapping approach for NTDs could save significant resources.
slots.clarification_sentence: This is true where these diseases geographically overlap.

slots.claim_sentence: The ITM protocol determines if a disease threshold has been reached in an implementation unit.
slots.clarification_sentence: This threshold triggers public health interventions.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers tested the ITM protocol by comparing it to current World Health Organization (WHO) mapping methodologies.
slots.clarification_sentence: The comparison took place in one district each in Mali and Senegal.

slots.claim_sentence: The ITM methodology reached the same conclusions as WHO methodologies for trachoma, lymphatic filariasis (LF), and soil-transmitted helminths (STH).
slots.clarification_sentence: These conclusions were about initiating public health interventions.

slots.claim_sentence: ITM resulted in more targeted intervention recommendations for schistosomiasis.
The ITM methodology was practical, feasible, and demonstrated overall cost savings.
slots.clarification_sentence: This was compared to standard, non-integrated WHO methodologies.

slots.claim_sentence: This integrated mapping tool could help implement much-needed NTD programs.
slots.clarification_sentence: These programs are for countries where NTDs are common.

slots.claim_sentence: Mutational analysis and imaging indicate that coronin organizes actin filaments for productive motility.
slots.clarification_sentence: This organization is essential for continuous and efficient movement of the sporozoites.

slots.clarification_sentence: Protein kinase A regulates the dynamics of actin filaments.

slots.claim_sentence: Calcium and cAMP-mediated signaling may regulate a switch from rapid parasite motility to host cell invasion.
slots.clarification_sentence: This regulation occurs by differentially influencing actin dynamics.

sentences.text: Malaria-causing parasites must migrate to penetrate tissue barriers and enter host cells.
The actin filament-binding protein coronin regulates gliding motility in Plasmodium berghei sporozoites.
Plasmodium berghei sporozoites are highly motile forms of a rodent malaria parasite.
Parasites lacking coronin show motility defects that impair colonization of mosquito salivary glands.
These defects result in decreased transmission efficiency, but do not affect migration in the skin.
In non-motile sporozoites, low calcium concentrations mediate actin-independent coronin localization to the periphery.
This localization occurs before the sporozoites become active and begin to move.
Extracellular ligands trigger an intracellular calcium release, which leads to actin-dependent coronin relocalization.
This relocalization of coronin to the rear initiates motility in the sporozoites.
Mutational analysis and imaging indicate that coronin organizes actin filaments for productive motility.
This organization is essential for continuous and efficient movement of the sporozoites.

Protein kinase A regulates the dynamics of actin filaments.

This regulation occurs by differentially influencing actin dynamics.

slots.claim_sentence: Proteins often perform their biological functions through collective atomic motions.
Identifying collective motions related to a specific protein function from molecular dynamics trajectories is often difficult.
The authors propose a new technique called 'functional mode analysis' (FMA) to detect collective motion directly related to a particular protein function.
Functional mode analysis uses an ensemble of protein structures and a 'functional quantity' to describe the protein's functional state.
slots.clarification_sentence: The technique detects the collective motion maximally correlated to this functional quantity.

slots.claim_sentence: The functional quantity can be a geometric, electrostatic, or chemical observable.
slots.clarification_sentence: It can also be any other variable relevant to protein function.

slots.claim_sentence: FMA also estimates the motion most likely to cause a substantial change in the functional quantity.
slots.clarification_sentence: This estimation considers the given protein ensemble. This 'ensemble-weighted MCM' identifies the most probable collective motion.

slots.claim_sentence: FMA applies two correlation measures: Pearson correlation coefficient and mutual information.
slots.clarification_sentence: Pearson correlation measures linear correlation, while mutual information assesses any kind of interdependence.

slots.claim_sentence: The new FMA approach is demonstrated using several biomolecules.
slots.clarification_sentence: These include a polyalanine-helix, T4 lysozyme, Trp-cage, and leucine-binding protein.

slots.claim_sentence: Coxsackievirus B (CVB) commonly causes a mild fever in infants.
slots.clarification_sentence: Severe CVB infection can lead to acute myocarditis, which is inflammation of the heart muscle.

slots.claim_sentence: The long-term effects of mild CVB infection are not known.
slots.clarification_sentence: There is an association between early subclinical infections and later heart failure.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers used a mouse model of juvenile infection with coxsackievirus B3 (CVB3).
slots.clarification_sentence: The subclinical dose of CVB3 caused no symptoms in young or adult mice.

slots.claim_sentence: After cardiac stress, juvenile-infected adult mice developed cardiac hypertrophy and dilation.
slots.clarification_sentence: These changes indicate a progression to heart failure.

slots.claim_sentence: Stressed adult hearts normally show an increase in CD31+ blood vessel formation.
slots.clarification_sentence: This compensatory effect was suppressed in juvenile-infected mice.

slots.claim_sentence: CVB3 efficiently infected juvenile c-kit+ cells.
slots.clarification_sentence: Cardiac progenitor cell numbers were reduced in juvenile-infected adult mice.

slots.claim_sentence: The reduced cardiac progenitor cell pool after juvenile CVB3 infection may impair the heart's ability to increase capillary density.
slots.clarification_sentence: This impairment could affect the heart's adaptation to increased load.

slots.claim_sentence: The filarial nematode Brugia malayi causes Lymphatic Filariasis.
Parasitic nematodes, including B. malayi, can modulate host biology.
slots.clarification_sentence: The mechanisms by which this manipulation occurs are not well understood.

slots.claim_sentence: Parasite-derived extracellular vesicles (EVs) are an emerging paradigm for secreting effector molecules.
slots.clarification_sentence: These EVs contain bioactive proteins and small RNA species that can be delivered to host tissues.

slots.claim_sentence: This study profiled extracellular vesicle (EV) release across all intra-mammalian life cycle stages of Brugia malayi.
slots.clarification_sentence: These stages include microfilariae, L3, L4, and adult male and female worms.

slots.claim_sentence: Extracellular vesicle (EV) release is a secretory process conserved across the life cycle of Brugia malayi.
Brugia malayi extracellular vesicles (EVs) are internalized by murine macrophages.
slots.clarification_sentence: There was no preference for the parasite's life stage during internalization.

slots.claim_sentence: All life stage extracellular vesicles (EVs) from Brugia malayi are internalized by phagocytosis.
Proteomic profiling of adult male and female Brugia malayi extracellular vesicles (EVs) revealed differences in their proteome.
slots.clarification_sentence: This suggests sexual dimorphic characteristics in immunomodulatory cargo.

slots.claim_sentence: Ivermectin rapidly inhibits extracellular vesicle (EV) release by all Brugia malayi life stages.
Ivermectin's inhibitory effect on EV release was also observed in Dirofilaria immitis.
slots.clarification_sentence: This effect was not seen in an ivermectin-unresponsive isolate of that parasite.
