slots.claim_sentence: Genetic variation in the major histocompatibility complex (MHC) affects CD4:CD8 lineage commitment and MHC expression.
The contribution of specific genes in the gene-dense MHC region to these effects was not yet resolved.
This study assessed the impact of natural genetic variation on MHC expression and CD4:CD8 lineage commitment.
slots.clarification_sentence: Researchers used two genetic models in rats for this assessment.

slots.claim_sentence: A large panel of MHC-recombinant congenic strains was generated to identify underlying genes.
slots.clarification_sentence: The QTLs were refined to two adjacent intervals of about 0.25 Mb in the MHC-I and MHC-II regions.

slots.claim_sentence: An interaction between these MHC-I and MHC-II intervals affected MHC class I expression.
slots.clarification_sentence: This interaction also affected negative selection and lineage commitment of CD8 single-positive (SP) thymocytes.

slots.claim_sentence: This interaction was mapped to Tap2 in the MHC-II region and RT1-A in the MHC-I region.
slots.clarification_sentence: Tap2 is the transporter associated with antigen processing 2, and RT1-A is a classical MHC class I gene.

slots.claim_sentence: Variants of Tap2 previously influenced the antigenicity of MHC class I molecules.
slots.clarification_sentence: This occurred by altering the MHC class I ligandome.

slots.claim_sentence: A restricted peptide repertoire on MHC class I molecules leads to reduced negative selection of CD8SP cells.
slots.clarification_sentence: This was shown by the study's results.

slots.claim_sentence: This is the first study showing how a recombination between natural alleles of genes in the MHC influences lineage commitment of T cells.

slots.claim_sentence: Spain is the European country with the highest expected number of Chagas disease infected patients.
slots.clarification_sentence: This is due to Spain receiving many migrants from Latin America.

slots.claim_sentence: The study described the evolution of Chagas disease in Spain from 1997 to 2011.
slots.clarification_sentence: Researchers used the National Health System’s Hospital Discharge Records Database (CMBD).

slots.claim_sentence: A total of 1729 hospitalization records related to Chagas disease were identified.
Hospitalization rates for Chagas disease in Spain increased from 18/100,000 population in 1997-2004.
slots.clarification_sentence: The rate rose to 242.8/100,000 population in 2005-2011.

slots.claim_sentence: Most hospitalized Chagas disease patients were female, at 74%.
slots.clarification_sentence: The 16-45 age-group was mostly represented, at 69.8%.

slots.claim_sentence: Overall, 23.4% of Chagas disease hospitalizations included a diagnosis with organ complications.
Being male was associated with hospitalizations with organ affectation.
slots.clarification_sentence: Being aged 45-64 years and having a median hospitalization cost above 3,065 euro were also associated with organ affectation.

slots.claim_sentence: Since 2005, the number of detected Chagas disease infections increased in Spain.
The predominant patient profile and conditions associated with organ affectation highlight a need for increased efforts.
slots.clarification_sentence: These efforts should focus on the early detection of T. cruzi.

slots.claim_sentence: EV71 infection led to an increase in exosome secretion.
slots.clarification_sentence: The exosomes also showed differential packaging of viral genomic RNA and miR-146a.

slots.claim_sentence: miR-146a was preferentially enriched in exosomes from EV71-infected cells.
slots.clarification_sentence: The viral RNA was not preferentially enriched in these exosomes. miR-146a was enriched by 24-fold in THP-1 cells and 17-fold in Hela cells.

slots.claim_sentence: Exosomes from EV71-infected cells contained replication-competent EV71 RNA.
slots.clarification_sentence: These exosomes could transmit EV71 infection without needing a specific viral receptor.

slots.claim_sentence: Exosomal viral RNA could transfer to and replicate in new target cells.
slots.clarification_sentence: Exosomal miR-146a suppressed the type I interferon response in these cells, which helped the virus replicate.

slots.claim_sentence: IFN-stimulated gene factors (ISGs) regulated EV71-induced exosome secretion.
slots.clarification_sentence: Specifically, BST-2/tetherin played a role in controlling this increased secretion.

slots.claim_sentence: An in vivo study showed that exosomal viral RNA accumulated differently in tissues.
slots.clarification_sentence: This accumulation differed compared to free virus particles. EV71 RNA was more enriched in the liver and spleen.

slots.claim_sentence: Exosomes from EV71-infected cells packaged high levels of miR-146a.
slots.clarification_sentence: This miR-146a can be transferred to recipient cells to suppress the type I interferon response and facilitate EV71 RNA replication.

slots.claim_sentence: The precise role of viral protein R (Vpr) during HIV-1 infection and its contribution to AIDS development remains unclear.
Previous reports showed that Vpr causes G2 cell cycle arrest and apoptosis in HIV-1-infected cells in vitro.
In a humanized mouse model, Vpr caused G2 cell cycle arrest and apoptosis in proliferating CCR5+ CD4+ T cells.
slots.clarification_sentence: These cells mainly consist of regulatory CD4+ T cells (Tregs), leading to Treg depletion and enhanced virus production during acute infection.

slots.claim_sentence: The Vpr-dependent enhancement of virus replication and Treg depletion was observed in CCR5-tropic HIV-1-infected mice.
slots.clarification_sentence: This effect was not seen in CXCR4-tropic HIV-1-infected mice, suggesting dependence on coreceptor usage.

slots.claim_sentence: Immune activation was observed in CCR5-tropic wild-type HIV-1-infected humanized mice.
slots.clarification_sentence: This activation was not present in vpr-deficient HIV-1-infected humanized mice.

slots.claim_sentence: Treating humanized mice with denileukin diftitox (DD) depleted Tregs.
slots.clarification_sentence: DD-treated mice showed massive activation and proliferation of memory T cells compared to untreated mice.

slots.claim_sentence: This activation and proliferation enhanced CCR5 expression in memory CD4+ T cells.
slots.clarification_sentence: This made them more susceptible to CCR5-tropic wild-type HIV-1 infection than to vpr-deficient virus.

slots.claim_sentence: Vpr takes advantage of proliferating CCR5+ CD4+ T cells to enhance viremia of CCR5-tropic HIV-1.
Tregs are more vulnerable to exploitation by Vpr during acute HIV-1 infection.
slots.clarification_sentence: This is because Tregs exist in a higher cycling state than other T cell subsets.

slots.claim_sentence: Several issues regarding RNA editing remain unresolved.
slots.clarification_sentence: These include how to accurately map the editome, its maintenance mechanism, and its evolutionary and functional relevance.

slots.claim_sentence: This study profiled the RNA editome for rhesus macaque, a close relative of humans.
slots.clarification_sentence: The profile is accurate and quantitative.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers identified 31,250 RNA editing sites in rhesus macaque.
slots.clarification_sentence: This was done by sequencing the genome and transcriptome from multiple tissues of the same animal.

slots.claim_sentence: Of the identified editing sites, 99.8% are A-to-G transitions.
The experimental methods were feasible.
slots.clarification_sentence: A high percentage of editing sites and levels were verified by multiple independent means.

slots.claim_sentence: Adenosine deamination is associated with the macaque editome.
slots.clarification_sentence: Sequence context and ADAR expression profiles influence RNA editing variance across sites and tissues.

slots.claim_sentence: Some editing sites show functional relevance.
slots.clarification_sentence: A 'substitution valley' of decreased divergence around these sites suggests evolutionary constraint to maintain their double-stranded structure.

slots.claim_sentence: These findings support the "continuous probing" model.
slots.clarification_sentence: This model suggests that a small proportion of functional editing sites originate through tinkering.

slots.claim_sentence: The macaque editome highlights RNA editing as widespread functional regulation in primate evolution.

slots.claim_sentence: Optimal decoding requires evaluating neural responses probabilistically by computing the likelihood function to form accurate perceptual judgments.
In two-alternative discrimination tasks, an optimal decoder precisely reads out the likelihood function at two specific stimulus alternatives.
slots.clarification_sentence: An optimal decoder calculates a ratio of likelihoods to maximize accuracy.

slots.claim_sentence: This study reports a new perceptual bias, indicating that observers read out the likelihood representation with low precision.
slots.clarification_sentence: This occurs when discriminating grating spatial frequencies, suggesting suboptimal decoding.

slots.claim_sentence: The study induced an asymmetry in the likelihood function of spatial frequency.
slots.clarification_sentence: This was done by using spectrally filtered noise.

slots.claim_sentence: This manipulation primarily affected the likelihood of spatial frequencies that were irrelevant to the discrimination task.
A significant shift in perceived grating frequency was found despite the manipulation mainly affecting irrelevant frequencies.
slots.clarification_sentence: This indicates that observers evaluate a broad range of irrelevant frequencies and discard prior knowledge during two-alternative discrimination.

slots.claim_sentence: Activation Induced Deaminase (AID) modifies DNA to start immunoglobulin gene diversification.
slots.clarification_sentence: AID deaminates cytosines in DNA to reprogram CpG methylation in early development.

slots.claim_sentence: AID is potentially highly mutagenic and causes genomic instability.
slots.clarification_sentence: This instability can lead to translocations in B cell malignancies.

slots.claim_sentence: This study demonstrates that AID is regulated by the cell cycle.
slots.clarification_sentence: AID abundance is regulated by the cell cycle.

slots.claim_sentence: AID undergoes nuclear degradation more slowly in G1 phase.
slots.clarification_sentence: This degradation is faster in S or G2-M phases.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers tested cell cycle regulation by fusing AID to tags.
slots.clarification_sentence: These tags destabilize nuclear protein outside of G1 or S-G2/M phases.

slots.claim_sentence: Enforced nuclear localization of AID in G1 phase accelerates somatic hypermutation and class switch recombination.
slots.clarification_sentence: This is well-tolerated, but nuclear AID compromises viability in S-G2/M phase cells.

slots.claim_sentence: The study identified AID derivatives that accelerate somatic hypermutation.
slots.clarification_sentence: These derivatives have minimal impact on viability and are useful tools for gene engineering.

slots.claim_sentence: Using cell cycle tags to regulate nuclear stability may apply to studying DNA repair.
slots.clarification_sentence: This method may also be useful for engineering the genome.

slots.claim_sentence: Lysozyme is an important antibacterial factor on mucosal surfaces.
slots.clarification_sentence: Bacteria must resist lysozyme's antibacterial properties for successful colonization.

slots.claim_sentence: Streptococcus pneumoniae modifies its peptidoglycan using two enzymes, PgdA and Adr.
slots.clarification_sentence: These enzymes have been linked to lysozyme resistance in laboratory studies.

slots.claim_sentence: The antimicrobial effect of human lysozyme comes from its muramidase activity.
slots.clarification_sentence: Both PgdA and Adr peptidoglycan modifications are needed for full resistance by pneumococci.

slots.claim_sentence: The study used competition experiments in mice to examine lysozyme's role in colonization.
slots.clarification_sentence: Researchers compared wild-type and pgdAadr mutant pneumococci in lysozyme M-sufficient and -deficient mice.

slots.claim_sentence: Wild-type Streptococcus pneumoniae out-competed the double mutant in lysozyme M-sufficient mice.
slots.clarification_sentence: This shows resistance to lysozyme's muramidase activity is important during mucosal colonization.

slots.claim_sentence: Individual peptidoglycan modifications by PgdA or Adr diminish fitness during colonization.
slots.clarification_sentence: These modifications confer a fitness cost on the organism.

slots.claim_sentence: The combination of peptidoglycan modifications reduces overall fitness in wild-type pneumococci.
slots.clarification_sentence: However, this fitness cost is outweighed by the benefits of resistance to lysozyme's peptidoglycan degrading activity.

slots.claim_sentence: Only lysozyme's enzymatic muramidase activity was relevant to pneumococcal survival.

slots.claim_sentence: Polyglutamine (polyQ) expansion in exon1 (XN1) of the huntingtin protein is linked to Huntington's disease.
When glutamines exceed 36–40 repeats, XN1 can form amyloid aggregates.
slots.clarification_sentence: Amyloid aggregates are clumps of misfolded proteins.

slots.claim_sentence: Understanding XN1 monomer misfolding can help determine the molecular mechanism of XN1 aggregation.
slots.clarification_sentence: This understanding could also help develop strategies to inhibit XN1 aggregation.

slots.claim_sentence: The study used molecular dynamics simulations to investigate monomeric XN1 misfolding.
slots.clarification_sentence: Researchers studied XN1 with full flanking regions, a variant missing polyproline regions, and an isolated polyQ peptide.

slots.claim_sentence: Longer polyQ peptides are more likely to form a β-rich misfolded state.
slots.clarification_sentence: This state is characterized by a high content of beta-sheet structures.

slots.claim_sentence: Polyproline regions form polyproline type II helices.
slots.clarification_sentence: These helices decrease the probability of the polyQ region forming a β-rich state.

slots.claim_sentence: Lengthening the polyQ region makes the first N-terminal 17 residues more likely to form a β-sheet conformation.
slots.clarification_sentence: This occurs instead of an α-helix conformation.

slots.claim_sentence: This molecular dynamics study offers structural insights into XN1 misfolding.
slots.clarification_sentence: It clarifies the potential role of flanking sequences in XN1 aggregation.

slots.claim_sentence: Helicobacter pylori (H. pylori) is a gastric pathogen with many simple sequence repeats (SSRs) that act as contingency loci.
slots.clarification_sentence: Contingency loci are hypermutable DNA segments that help bacteria adapt to changing environments.

slots.claim_sentence: This study presents a model where a T-tract, located between genes, acts like a rheostat to fine-tune the SabA adhesin promoter activity in H. pylori.
slots.clarification_sentence: A rheostat-like function means it can gradually adjust gene expression levels.

slots.claim_sentence: Using T-tract variants, the study showed that the T-tract length generates multiphasic output from the sabA promoter.
slots.clarification_sentence: Multiphasic output means different T-tract lengths lead to varying levels of promoter activity.

slots.claim_sentence: This alteration in T-tract length changes H. pylori's binding to sialyl-Lewis x receptors on gastric mucosa.
slots.clarification_sentence: Sialyl-Lewis x receptors are sugar molecules on the stomach lining that H. pylori binds to.

slots.claim_sentence: Fragment length analysis of post-infection clones showed that the T-tract length is a highly variable feature in H. pylori.
Analyses revealed that T-tract length affects local DNA structure, altering RNA polymerase binding.
slots.clarification_sentence: RNA polymerase is an enzyme essential for gene expression.

slots.claim_sentence: The study identified other H. pylori genes with T- or A-tracts similar to sabA.
slots.clarification_sentence: Variations in these tract lengths also modulated promoter output like rheostats.

slots.claim_sentence: This generally applicable mechanism, mediated by promoter-proximal SSRs, offers an alternative for transcriptional regulation in bacteria.
slots.clarification_sentence: This is important for bacteria like H. pylori, which have few classical trans-acting regulatory factors.

slots.claim_sentence: High-risk human papillomavirus (HPV) must evade innate immune surveillance to establish persistent infections.
slots.clarification_sentence: HPV also needs to amplify viral genomes upon differentiation.

slots.claim_sentence: HPV proteins downregulate expression of STAT-1.
slots.clarification_sentence: This allows for stable maintenance of viral episomes. STAT-1 is a member of the JAK-STAT family.

slots.claim_sentence: HPV E7 activates STAT-5 phosphorylation.
slots.clarification_sentence: This occurs without altering total protein levels of STAT-5. The E7 protein is primarily responsible for enhanced phosphorylation of STAT-5.

slots.claim_sentence: Inhibition of STAT-5 phosphorylation by pimozide abolishes viral genome amplification.
slots.clarification_sentence: Pimozide also abolishes late gene expression in differentiating keratinocytes.

slots.claim_sentence: Treatment of undifferentiated cells with pimozide has no effect on viral replication.
slots.clarification_sentence: These cells stably maintain HPV episomes.

slots.claim_sentence: The STAT-5β isoform is mainly responsible for this activity.
slots.clarification_sentence: This activity is mediated through the ATM DNA damage response. Knockdown studies confirmed this dependency.

slots.claim_sentence: Peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor γ (PPARγ) contributes to effects on the ATM pathway.
slots.clarification_sentence: PPARγ is a downstream target of STAT-5.

slots.claim_sentence: STAT-5 promotes HPV viral replication.
slots.clarification_sentence: This occurs through activation of the ATM DNA damage response.

slots.claim_sentence: Recombination in enteroviruses is an evolutionary mechanism for acquiring novel sequences.
slots.clarification_sentence: This mechanism has been key to the emergence of neuropathogenic variants of poliovirus.

slots.claim_sentence: Despite its importance, the recombination process in enteroviruses remains poorly understood.
The study investigated heterologous recombination using a novel reverse genetic approach.
slots.clarification_sentence: This approach isolated intermediate chimeric polioviruses with duplicated sequences at the recombination junction.

slots.claim_sentence: Serial passage of these viruses with imprecise junctions yielded progeny with increased fitness.
slots.clarification_sentence: These progeny had lost the duplicated sequences.

slots.claim_sentence: Changes in polymerase fidelity or replication complex coalescence altered the yield of recombinants.
slots.clarification_sentence: This indicates that the recombination process is replicative and can be modulated.

slots.claim_sentence: The authors propose that extant recombinants result from a biphasic process.
slots.clarification_sentence: This process involves an initial recombination event followed by a resolution process, deleting extraneous sequences and optimizing viral fitness.

slots.claim_sentence: This biphasic process has implications for understanding 'evolution by duplication' in positive-strand RNA viruses.
slots.clarification_sentence: The study provides insights into the molecular mechanism of recombination.

slots.claim_sentence: It may be possible to enhance or reduce recombination-mediated viral evolution.

slots.claim_sentence: Organ aging is linked to a reduction in stem cell occupancy within their niches.
slots.clarification_sentence: The mechanisms involved in this process are poorly understood.

slots.claim_sentence: Notch signaling is increased with age in Drosophila female germline stem cells (GSCs).
slots.clarification_sentence: This increase results in their removal from the niche.

slots.claim_sentence: Drosophila GSCs with low Notch signaling levels show increased adhesiveness to the niche.
slots.clarification_sentence: Adhesiveness is altered through the regulation of E-cadherin expression.

slots.claim_sentence: Experimentally enhancing Notch signaling in Drosophila GSCs accelerates their age-dependent loss from the niche.
slots.clarification_sentence: This loss is partially mediated by Sex lethal.

slots.claim_sentence: Notch activation in the niche is reduced with age in Drosophila.
slots.clarification_sentence: Niche Notch activation maintains niche integrity and GSC retention.

slots.claim_sentence: Notch signaling regulates Drosophila GSC niche occupancy both intrinsically and extrinsically.
slots.clarification_sentence: Intrinsic regulation occurs within GSCs, and extrinsic regulation occurs within the niche.

slots.claim_sentence: The findings expose a novel role of Notch signaling in controlling GSC-niche adhesion in response to aging.
slots.clarification_sentence: This is also relevant to metastatic cancer cells, where Notch signaling suppresses cell adhesion.

slots.claim_sentence: The study aimed to investigate the demographics and clinical characteristics associated with dengue deaths in Malaysia.
Researchers conducted a retrospective review of all dengue deaths nationwide in Malaysia.
slots.clarification_sentence: This review covered deaths between January 1, 2013, and December 31, 2014.

slots.claim_sentence: A total of 322 dengue deaths were reviewed in the study.
Adults accounted for 72.5% of dengue deaths in Malaysia.
slots.clarification_sentence: Most adults were from the working age group of 15–59 years.

slots.claim_sentence: Diabetes and hypertension were common co-morbidities among adult and elderly dengue patients.
About 22.4% of dengue deaths did not have any warning signs.
slots.clarification_sentence: This made early diagnosis challenging for these patients.

slots.claim_sentence: Global manipulation of insulin signaling affects female sexual attractiveness in the fruit fly, Drosophila melanogaster.
slots.clarification_sentence: Insulin signaling is a nutrient-sensing pathway.

slots.claim_sentence: Insulin signaling effects on attractiveness derive from the fat body and ovarian follicle cells.
slots.clarification_sentence: Pheromone-producing oenocytes integrate these signals. Oenocytes are cells that produce pheromones.

slots.claim_sentence: Functional ovaries were required for global insulin signaling effects on attractiveness.
slots.clarification_sentence: Manipulations in late follicle cells mimicked global effects.

slots.claim_sentence: Modulation of insulin signaling in the fat body produced opposite effects on attractiveness.
slots.clarification_sentence: This suggests a competitive relationship with the ovary.

slots.claim_sentence: Tissue-specific insulin signaling manipulations that changed attractiveness also changed fecundity.
slots.clarification_sentence: Insulin pathway activity reliably links fecundity and attractiveness cues. Fecundity refers to the ability to produce offspring.

slots.claim_sentence: Cuticular hydrocarbons, which are attractiveness cues, responded distinctly to fat body and follicle cell manipulations.
slots.clarification_sentence: This indicates independent readouts of pathway activity from these two tissues. Cuticular hydrocarbons are chemical compounds that act as pheromones.

slots.claim_sentence: Female attractiveness results from a connection between attractiveness cues and high fecundity.
slots.clarification_sentence: This connection is created by lowered insulin signaling in the fat body and increased signaling in late follicle cells.

slots.claim_sentence: HIV infection is currently incurable but can be controlled with combination antiretroviral drug treatment.
Determining the optimal drug combination for effective treatment is a key challenge due to different viral genotypes for each patient.
Current computational models for predicting HIV treatment regimens only use sequence data from viral genotyping.
slots.clarification_sentence: These models do not consider the chemical similarity of drugs.

slots.claim_sentence: The researchers applied proteochemometric (PCM) models to include chemical similarity in predicting HIV drug resistance.
slots.clarification_sentence: PCM models combine chemical and protein target properties in a single bioactivity model.

slots.claim_sentence: The study used a large-scale clinical database with approximately 300,000 drug-mutant bioactivity data points.
Proteochemometric models performed better in resistance classification and prediction of Log Fold Change.
slots.clarification_sentence: This was compared to previously published sequence data-derived models.

slots.claim_sentence: The study confirmed known and identified previously unpublished resistance-conferring mutations of HIV Reverse Transcriptase and HIV Protease.
The models achieved an 84% correct resistance prediction rate when applied to the Stanford University HIV resistance database.
slots.clarification_sentence: This rate was 80% in previous work on a high-quality subset.

slots.claim_sentence: Proteochemometric models can accurately predict phenotypic resistance based on genotypic data.
slots.clarification_sentence: This applies even for novel mutants and mixtures.

slots.claim_sentence: The study added an applicability domain to the prediction.
slots.clarification_sentence: This informs users about the reliability of predictions.

slots.claim_sentence: There is no direct genetic evidence to support that suberin forms a chemical barrier in plant roots.
slots.clarification_sentence: This barrier would limit the extracellular transport of water and solutes. Suberin is a waxy layer in plant roots.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers studied the enhanced suberin1 (esb1) mutant in Arabidopsis thaliana.
slots.clarification_sentence: This mutant helped connect root suberin to water movement and solute accumulation in the shoot. The esb1 mutant has a doubling of all aliphatic monomer components of root suberin.

slots.claim_sentence: Esb1 mutants have increased root suberin.
slots.clarification_sentence: These mutants showed reduced daytime transpiration rates and increased water-use efficiency during growth. The esb1 mutant has significantly higher root suberin compared to wild type plants.

slots.claim_sentence: Changes in suberin and water transport decreased Ca, Mn, and Zn accumulation in the shoot.
slots.clarification_sentence: Na, S, K, As, Se, and Mo accumulation increased in the shoot. The esb1 mutant showed a 50% reduction in Ca and a 40% increase in Na.

slots.claim_sentence: This study provides direct genetic evidence that root suberin controls water and mineral ion uptake.
slots.clarification_sentence: Suberin also controls the transport of these substances to the leaves.

slots.claim_sentence: Changes in elemental accumulation in leaves suggest radial root transport of Ca, Mn, and Zn.
slots.clarification_sentence: A significant part of this transport occurs in the apoplast. This confirms earlier conclusions about a root apoplastic bypass pathway for Ca.

slots.claim_sentence: This research focused on Nectria haematococca mating population VI (MPVI), a member of the Fusarium solani species complex.
slots.clarification_sentence: Nectria haematococca MPVI is a fungus that can cause diseases in plants and opportunistic infections in humans.

slots.claim_sentence: Genes that control the ability of Nectria haematococca MPVI isolates to colonize specific habitats are located on supernumerary chromosomes.
slots.clarification_sentence: Supernumerary chromosomes are extra chromosomes that are not always essential for survival.

slots.claim_sentence: The Nectria haematococca MPVI genome is 54.43 Mb and has 15,707 predicted genes.
slots.clarification_sentence: These numbers are among the largest reported for ascomycetes, a group of fungi.

slots.claim_sentence: Gene expansion in Nectria haematococca MPVI is due to specific genes not found in other fungi, including Fusarium graminearum.
slots.clarification_sentence: Gene expansion also results from genes present in multiple copies that typically occur as single copies in other fungi.

slots.claim_sentence: Some additional genes in Nectria haematococca MPVI appear to have resulted from gene duplication events.
slots.clarification_sentence: Other genes may have been acquired through horizontal gene transfer, a process where genetic material moves between organisms.

slots.claim_sentence: The supernumerary nature of chromosomes 14, 15, and 17 was confirmed in Nectria haematococca MPVI.
Supernumerary chromosomes contain more repeat sequences and are enriched in unique and duplicated genes.
The gene expansion and large genome size of Nectria haematococca MPVI are consistent with its diverse range of habitats.
Unique genes on supernumerary chromosomes might explain why individual Nectria haematococca MPVI isolates occupy different environmental niches.

slots.claim_sentence: Disease-causing mtDNA mutations were more frequent on young sequences.

slots.claim_sentence: The mtDNA background generally influences recurrent mutation events.
slots.clarification_sentence: These events have been purified through natural selection in older populations.

slots.claim_sentence: The study's findings explain the low frequency of mtDNA disease in specific ethnic groups.
slots.clarification_sentence: The clinical interpretation of mtDNA variants should be performed within an ethnogeographic context.

slots.claim_sentence: Many viruses encode proteins that evade or disable the host's T cell response.
Most viruses are readily detected by host T cells and induce relatively strong T cell responses.
The study used transgenic CD4+ and CD8+ T cells as sensors.
slots.clarification_sentence: These cells evaluated antigen presentation by coxsackievirus B3 (CVB3) in vitro and in vivo.

slots.clarification_sentence: This inhibition allows CVB3 to evade CD8+ T cell immunity. CVB3 carries a powerful punch.

slots.claim_sentence: The presentation of CVB3-encoded MHC class II epitopes is relatively unencumbered.
slots.clarification_sentence: CVB3 induces phenotypically normal CD4+ T cell responses in vivo.

slots.claim_sentence: The CD4+ T cells induced by CVB3 display an effector phenotype.
slots.clarification_sentence: These cells mature into multi-functional CVB3-specific memory CD4+ T cells. These memory cells expand dramatically following challenge infection.

slots.claim_sentence: The findings have implications for the efficiency of antigen cross-presentation.
slots.clarification_sentence: This applies during coxsackievirus infection.

slots.claim_sentence: Stomatal pores on plant leaves regulate carbon dioxide uptake for photosynthesis and water loss through transpiration.
Stomatal aperture influences photosynthesis, water use efficiency, and agricultural crop yields.
The signal transduction pathways linking light perception to stomatal opening are largely unknown.
This study reports two new players, Hypersensitive to Red and Blue 1 (HRB1) and Protein Phosphatase 7 (PP7).
slots.clarification_sentence: These proteins have genetic and biochemical interactions in controlling stomatal aperture.

slots.claim_sentence: Mutations in either HRB1 or PP7 lead to misregulation of stomatal aperture.
slots.clarification_sentence: These mutations also reduce water loss under blue light.

slots.claim_sentence: HRB1 interacts with PP7 through its N-terminal ZZ-type zinc finger motif.
slots.clarification_sentence: HRB1 requires a functional PP7 for its stomatal opening response.

slots.claim_sentence: HRB1 is phosphorylated in vivo.
slots.clarification_sentence: PP7 can dephosphorylate HRB1.

slots.claim_sentence: In the pp7 mutant, the size shift of the HRB1 complex is impaired.
slots.clarification_sentence: HRB1 is predominantly phosphorylated in the pp7 mutant.

slots.claim_sentence: Modification of HRB1 by PP7 under blue light is essential for proper conformation.
slots.clarification_sentence: This modification is also essential for the assembly of a functional HRB1 protein complex.

slots.claim_sentence: This study may provide strategies for plants to benefit from constitutive protection.
slots.clarification_sentence: It may also provide strategies for ABA-induced protection under water-limiting conditions.

slots.clarification_sentence: These disorders include Parkinson's disease and essential tremor (ET).

slots.claim_sentence: New closed-loop DBS approaches deliver stimulation based on ongoing symptoms or brain activity.
slots.clarification_sentence: These approaches may improve efficiency, efficacy, and reduce side effects.

slots.claim_sentence: The success of closed-loop DBS depends on minimizing neural activity oscillations.
slots.clarification_sentence: These oscillations are linked to symptoms of motor disorders.

slots.claim_sentence: Our work uses a reduced Kuramoto model of coupled oscillators.
slots.clarification_sentence: This model represents neurons that generate pathological oscillations. The mathematical model helps analyze how brain oscillations change with stimulation.

slots.claim_sentence: The most effective stimulation strategy should be phase-specific.
slots.clarification_sentence: Stimulation should have a greater effect when applied at lower amplitudes of brain oscillations. This prediction suggests that both the timing and strength of brain oscillations are important.

slots.claim_sentence: We compare this prediction with experimental data from essential tremor (ET) patients.
slots.clarification_sentence: The predictions were satisfied in one patient.

slots.claim_sentence: Based on our predictions, we propose a new hybrid stimulation strategy.
slots.clarification_sentence: This strategy combines phase-locked and adaptive closed-loop DBS. This hybrid approach aims to optimize DBS by integrating different methods.

slots.claim_sentence: The origins of modern European populations have been debated.
slots.clarification_sentence: Scientists have discussed the contributions of Paleolithic hunter-gatherers and Neolithic farmers from the Near East.

slots.claim_sentence: Haplogroup R1b1b2 (R-M269) is the most common Y-chromosomal lineage in Europe.
slots.clarification_sentence: This lineage is carried by 110 million European men. Its frequency increases from east to west across Europe.

slots.claim_sentence: Previous studies suggested a Paleolithic origin for Haplogroup R1b1b2.
slots.clarification_sentence: This study indicates its spread from a single source in the Near East via Anatolia during the Neolithic period. The geographical distribution of its microsatellite diversity supports this finding.

slots.claim_sentence: Evidence from other haplogroups suggests most European Y chromosomes originated during the Neolithic expansion.
Europe is an example of how technological and cultural changes link with Y-chromosomal lineage expansion.
slots.clarification_sentence: This pattern contrasts with maternally inherited mitochondrial DNA, suggesting a unique role for males in the Neolithic transition.

slots.claim_sentence: Staphylococcus aureus expresses cell wall-anchored proteins that mediate adhesion, invasion, and immune evasion.
slots.clarification_sentence: These proteins contribute to the virulence of the organism.

slots.claim_sentence: Clumping factor B (ClfB) is a cell wall-anchored protein.
slots.clarification_sentence: ClfB facilitates S. aureus nasal colonization by interacting with the cornified envelope.

slots.claim_sentence: The role of ClfB during skin and soft tissue infection (SSTI) had not been investigated.
This study reveals a novel role for ClfB during S. aureus SSTIs.
ClfB is crucial for determining the abscess structure and bacterial burden early in infection.
slots.clarification_sentence: This is dependent upon a specific interaction with the ligand loricrin.

slots.claim_sentence: Targeting ClfB with a model vaccine led to protection during S. aureus skin infection.
slots.clarification_sentence: The vaccine induced both protective humoral and cellular responses.

slots.claim_sentence: This study identifies ClfB as an important antigen for future SSTI vaccines.

slots.claim_sentence: The Saccharomyces cerevisiae polo-like kinase Cdc5 promotes adaptation to the DNA damage checkpoint.
Adaptation occurs when cells with persistent DNA damage escape the cell-cycle arrest.
slots.clarification_sentence: This arrest is normally imposed by the DNA damage checkpoint.

slots.claim_sentence: CDC5 is dose-dependent for adaptation.
slots.clarification_sentence: Overexpression of CDC5 promotes faster adaptation.

slots.claim_sentence: The study overexpressed CDC5 from the GAL1 promoter in damaged cells.
slots.clarification_sentence: This method examined key steps in checkpoint activation.

slots.claim_sentence: Cdc5 overproduction had little effect on the early steps leading to Rad53 activation.
slots.clarification_sentence: These early steps include checkpoint sensor localization and Rad9-Rad53 complex formation.

slots.claim_sentence: Rad53 hyperphosphorylation was significantly reduced.
slots.clarification_sentence: This reduction is consistent with the loss of cell-cycle arrest during adaptation.

slots.claim_sentence: Cdc5 attenuates the DNA damage checkpoint through loss of Rad53 hyperphosphorylation.
slots.clarification_sentence: This allows cells to adapt to DNA damage.

slots.claim_sentence: Polo-like kinase homologs inhibit Claspin's ability to activate downstream checkpoint kinases.
slots.clarification_sentence: This function is suggested to be conserved in vertebrates.

slots.claim_sentence: The Aedes aegypti mosquito is the primary vector for arboviruses like dengue, Zika, chikungunya, and yellow fever viruses.
Enveloped viruses use cellular membranes for replication, assembly, and release by manipulating host metabolism.
The mosquito midgut is the primary site of dengue virus infection and replication.
slots.clarification_sentence: This site precedes systemic viral dissemination and transmission.

slots.claim_sentence: High-resolution mass spectrometry analyzed metabolic changes in the Aedes aegypti midgut.
slots.clarification_sentence: These changes occurred after dengue virus infection.

slots.claim_sentence: A marked increase in lipid content was observed in the mosquito midgut.
slots.clarification_sentence: This increase occurred during dengue virus infection.

slots.claim_sentence: Increases in glycerophospholipids, sphingolipids, and fatty acyls coincided with viral replication.
Elevated glycerolipid levels suggested a diversion of resources during infection.
slots.clarification_sentence: Resources shifted from energy storage to synthetic pathways.

slots.claim_sentence: A central hub in the sphingolipid pathway was critical for the virus life cycle.
slots.clarification_sentence: This hub influenced dihydroceramide to ceramide ratios. Altering this ratio reduced viral genome replication.

slots.claim_sentence: The results highlight biochemical choke points that could disrupt transmission of multiple flaviviruses.
slots.clarification_sentence: These points could be targeted in Aedes aegypti mosquitoes.

slots.claim_sentence: The NSP-interacting kinase (NIK) receptor-mediated defense pathway is a virulence target of the geminivirus nuclear shuttle protein (NSP).
slots.clarification_sentence: This pathway is a plant innate immune system component.

slots.claim_sentence: The molecular mechanism linking the NIK1–NSP antiviral response to receptor activation remained obscure.
Ribosomal protein rpL10A was identified as a specific partner and substrate of NIK1.
slots.clarification_sentence: This protein functions as an immediate downstream effector of the NIK1-mediated response.

slots.claim_sentence: Phosphorylation of cytosolic rpL10A by NIK1 redirects the protein to the nucleus.
slots.clarification_sentence: In the nucleus, rpL10A may act to modulate viral infection.

slots.claim_sentence: Ectopic expression of normal NIK1 or a hyperactive NIK1 mutant promotes phosphorylated rpL10A accumulation in the nuclei.
slots.clarification_sentence: An inactive NIK1 mutant fails to redirect the protein to the nuclei.

slots.claim_sentence: Loss of rpL10A function enhances susceptibility to geminivirus infection.
slots.clarification_sentence: This resembles the phenotype of nik1 null alleles.

slots.claim_sentence: Geminivirus infection directly interferes with NIK1-mediated nuclear relocalization of rpL10A.
slots.clarification_sentence: This interference acts as a counterdefensive measure by the virus.

slots.claim_sentence: The NIK1-mediated defense signaling inhibits plant growth and development.
slots.clarification_sentence: This inhibition is a cost of the defense response.

slots.claim_sentence: The NIK1-mediated signaling response may be involved in restricting the host range of other viruses.

slots.claim_sentence: Entry into mitosis is triggered by the activation of Cdk1 and the inactivation of its counteracting phosphatase PP2A/B55.
Greatwall kinase inactivates PP2A/B55 via its substrates Ensa and ARPP19.
The dynamic regulation of Greatwall activity and the phosphatases that control Greatwall kinase and its substrates are poorly understood.
The study used mathematical modeling and experiments with phospho-specific antibodies to monitor protein phosphorylation.
slots.clarification_sentence: This included Greatwall, Ensa/ARPP19, and Cdk substrate phosphorylation during mitotic entry and exit.

slots.claim_sentence: PP2A/B55 is required for Greatwall (Gwl) dephosphorylation at the essential Cdk site Thr194.
slots.clarification_sentence: Thr194 is a conserved threonine residue. Thr194 is phosphorylated during mitosis in human cells.

slots.claim_sentence: Ensa/ARPP19 dephosphorylation is mediated by the RNA Polymerase II carboxy terminal domain phosphatase Fcp1.
Inhibition or depletion of neither Fcp1 nor PP2A appears to block dephosphorylation of most mitotic Cdk1 substrates.
slots.clarification_sentence: This occurs during mitotic exit.

slots.claim_sentence: The results suggest a hierarchy of phosphatases coordinates Greatwall, Ensa/ARPP19, and Cdk substrate dephosphorylation.
slots.clarification_sentence: This coordination happens during mitotic exit.

slots.claim_sentence: Aedes aegypti is the primary mosquito vector for all four serotypes of dengue virus (DENV).
The Neovolcanic axis (NVA) in Veracruz, Mexico, acts as a barrier to gene flow among Aedes aegypti populations.
slots.clarification_sentence: This barrier occurs where the NVA intersects with the Gulf of Mexico coast.

slots.claim_sentence: Aedes aegypti mosquito populations north and south of the NVA differ in their vector competence for dengue serotype 2 virus (DENV2).
slots.clarification_sentence: Vector competence is the ability of a mosquito to transmit a virus.

slots.claim_sentence: The average vector competence rate for mosquitoes north of the NVA was 0.55.
slots.clarification_sentence: In contrast, the average rate for mosquitoes south of the NVA was 0.20.

slots.claim_sentence: Most of this variation in vector competence was due to midgut infection and escape barriers.
slots.clarification_sentence: These barriers are physiological mechanisms in the mosquitoes. Midgut infection barriers prevent the virus from infecting the mosquito's gut. Midgut escape barriers prevent the virus from spreading from the gut.

slots.claim_sentence: Barriers to gene flow in vector populations can influence the frequency of genes.
slots.clarification_sentence: These genes determine epidemiologically relevant traits like vector competence.

slots.claim_sentence: The DnaA protein drives the bacterial replication cycle.
slots.clarification_sentence: This protein cycles between an active ATP-bound form and an inactive ADP-bound form.

slots.claim_sentence: Initiation of bacterial replication is thought to occur when enough ATP-DnaA has accumulated.
slots.clarification_sentence: This is a common hypothesis in the field.

slots.claim_sentence: The study performed cell cycle analysis of cells with a surplus of ATP-DnaA.
slots.clarification_sentence: This analysis aimed to determine if replication initiation would occur earlier.

slots.claim_sentence: Initiation did not occur earlier in cells with a surplus of ATP-DnaA.
slots.clarification_sentence: The amount of DnaA in the cell is not likely the limiting factor for initiation.

slots.claim_sentence: Cells with more than a 50% increase in ATP-DnaA concentration showed no changes in replication timing.
The accumulation of ATP-DnaA does not control the time of replication initiation.
slots.clarification_sentence: ATP-DnaA is the main actor in the initiation process.

slots.claim_sentence: Other factors are required for the exact timing of initiation in response to the cell’s environment.
The study also investigated the in vivo roles of DDAH and DiaA.
slots.clarification_sentence: DDAH is datA dependent DnaA inactivation, and DiaA is a DnaA-binding protein.

slots.claim_sentence: Loss of DDAH affected the cell cycle machinery only during slow growth.
slots.clarification_sentence: This loss also made the machinery sensitive to the concentration of DiaA protein.

slots.claim_sentence: The Drosophila genes spalt major (salm) and spalt-related (salr) encode Zn-finger transcription factors.
slots.clarification_sentence: These transcription factors are regulated by the Decapentaplegic (Dpp) signalling pathway in the Drosophila wing imaginal disc.

slots.claim_sentence: The function of salm and salr genes is required for cell survival and proliferation in the central region of the Drosophila wing disc.
slots.clarification_sentence: These genes are also essential for vein patterning in the lateral regions of the wing disc.

slots.claim_sentence: Identifying direct Salm and Salr target genes and analyzing their functions are critical steps to understand the genetic control of growth and patterning of the Drosophila wing imaginal disc by the Dpp pathway.
The study identified candidate Salm/Salr target genes by comparing the expression profile of salm/salr knockdown wing discs with control discs using microarray experiments.
The study uncovered a complex transcription landscape regulated by Spalt proteins in the Drosophila wing disc.

slots.claim_sentence: In areas where visceral leishmaniasis is common, many infected individuals become asymptomatic carriers due to a protective cellular immune response.

slots.claim_sentence: The assay using soluble leishmania antigen (SLA) showed 80% sensitivity and 100% specificity.
slots.clarification_sentence: SLA was the most effective single antigen preparation.

slots.claim_sentence: A whole-blood SLA-based QuantiFERON assay can measure the cell-mediated immune response in L. donovani infection.
slots.clarification_sentence: The assay helps assess immune reactivity against L. donovani.

slots.claim_sentence: A positive interferon-gamma response to leishmania antigen in active visceral leishmaniasis patients was unexpected.
slots.clarification_sentence: This finding contradicts conventional understanding and needs further research.

slots.claim_sentence: The scientific literature and high-throughput instruments are rapidly expanding in molecular biomedicine, making it challenging for researchers.
This paper describes a new computational approach, a knowledge-based system, to analyze experimental data.
slots.clarification_sentence: The system combines reading, reasoning, and reporting methods.

slots.claim_sentence: Reading methods extract information from external resources, including structured and unstructured data.
slots.clarification_sentence: Biomedical language processing is used for unstructured data, and the system tracks knowledge provenance.

slots.claim_sentence: Reasoning methods enrich the extracted knowledge by noting when two genes share an ontology term or database entry.
Reasoning also combines all sources into a knowledge network, representing relationships between gene pairs.
slots.clarification_sentence: The system calculates a combined reliability score for these relationships.

slots.claim_sentence: Reporting methods combine the knowledge network with experimental data.
slots.clarification_sentence: The combined network is visualized in a tool for knowledge-based analysis.

slots.claim_sentence: An implementation of this approach, called the Hanalyzer, was demonstrated.
slots.clarification_sentence: The Hanalyzer used a large-scale gene expression array dataset relevant to craniofacial development.

slots.claim_sentence: The Hanalyzer was crucial in generating hypotheses about four genes not previously known to be involved in craniofacial development.
slots.clarification_sentence: Further experimental work validated these hypotheses.

slots.claim_sentence: Folliculogenesis requires bidirectional communication between the oocyte and granulosa cells.
slots.clarification_sentence: Folliculogenesis is the process of ovarian follicle development.

slots.claim_sentence: The underlying mechanism for establishing oocyte-granulosa cell communication is largely unknown.
Oocyte geranylgeranyl diphosphate (GGPP) is required to establish oocyte-granulosa cell communication.
slots.clarification_sentence: GGPP is a metabolic intermediate involved in protein geranylgeranylation.

slots.claim_sentence: Selective depletion of GGPP in mouse oocytes impaired primary-secondary follicle transition and female fertility.
slots.clarification_sentence: It also impaired the proliferation of granulosa cells.

slots.claim_sentence: GGPP depletion inhibited Rho GTPase geranylgeranylation and its GTPase activity.
slots.clarification_sentence: This led to a failure to maintain physical connection between oocyte and granulosa cells.

slots.claim_sentence: GGPP ablation also blocked Rab27a geranylgeranylation.
slots.clarification_sentence: This might account for the impaired secretion of oocyte materials such as Gdf9.

slots.claim_sentence: GGPP administration restored defects in oocyte-granulosa cell contact in Ggpps depletion mice.
slots.clarification_sentence: It also restored granulosa cell proliferation and primary-secondary follicle transition.

slots.claim_sentence: GGPP-mediated protein geranylgeranylation contributes to oocyte-granulosa cell communication.
slots.clarification_sentence: This process regulates the primary-secondary follicle transition.

slots.claim_sentence: Defects in primary cilia cause inherited human disorders called ciliopathies.
slots.clarification_sentence: These include retinitis pigmentosa and Bardet-Biedl syndrome (BBS).

slots.claim_sentence: Cilium formation, maintenance, and function depend on intracellular transport systems like intraflagellar transport (IFT).
slots.clarification_sentence: The Bardet-Biedl syndrome (BBS) cargo-adaptor protein complex, or BBSome, regulates IFT.

slots.claim_sentence: The study used the nematode C. elegans to identify new cilium-associated genes.
slots.clarification_sentence: Ciliogenesis occurs during late embryogenesis in C. elegans.

slots.claim_sentence: Whole-organism RNA-Seq libraries helped discover a signature expression profile.
slots.clarification_sentence: This profile was highly enriched for transcripts of known ciliary proteins.

slots.claim_sentence: From 185 candidate ciliary genes, the study identified orthologues of human MAP9, YAP, CCDC149, and RAB28.
slots.clarification_sentence: These are conserved cilium-associated components.

slots.claim_sentence: C. elegans RAB-28 is exclusively expressed in ciliated neurons.
slots.clarification_sentence: This small GTPase dynamically associates with IFT trains.

slots.claim_sentence: GTP-bound (activated) RAB-28 concentrates at the periciliary membrane.
slots.clarification_sentence: It undergoes bidirectional IFT in a BBSome-dependent manner.

slots.claim_sentence: Overexpression of predicted GDP or GTP locked variants of RAB-28 perturbs cilium and sensory pore morphogenesis.
slots.clarification_sentence: It also perturbs their function.

slots.claim_sentence: The findings present a new approach for identifying ciliary proteins.
slots.clarification_sentence: They unveil RAB28 as an IFT-associated cargo with BBSome-dependent functions at the ciliary base.

slots.claim_sentence: Combination chemotherapy with oral rifampicin and intramuscular streptomycin improved Buruli ulcer treatment.
slots.clarification_sentence: This treatment also reduced recurrence rates for Buruli ulcer.

slots.claim_sentence: Wound healing is delayed in some antibiotic-treated Buruli ulcer patients.
slots.clarification_sentence: The reasons for these delays are not fully understood.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers performed immunohistochemical investigations to identify markers.
slots.clarification_sentence: These markers could monitor wound healing progression in Buruli ulcer patients.

slots.claim_sentence: Tissue specimens from eight Buruli ulcer patients were analyzed.
slots.clarification_sentence: Specimens were collected before, during, and after chemotherapy for markers of tissue repair.

slots.claim_sentence: Alpha-smooth muscle actin positive myofibroblasts emerged during the healing process.
slots.clarification_sentence: These myofibroblasts were not found in untreated Buruli ulcer lesions.

slots.claim_sentence: These myofibroblasts produced abundant extracellular matrix proteins.
slots.clarification_sentence: Examples include pro-collagen 1 and tenascin, found in fibronectin-rich areas.

slots.claim_sentence: After antibiotic treatment, many cells showed an activated phenotype.
slots.clarification_sentence: This activation included ribosomal protein S6 phosphorylation, a marker for translation initiation.

slots.claim_sentence: Healing wounds showed dermal tissue remodeling by apoptosis.
slots.clarification_sentence: They also showed increased cytokeratin 16 expression in the epidermis.

slots.claim_sentence: This identified marker panel may help understand disturbances.
slots.clarification_sentence: These disturbances are responsible for wound healing delays in some Buruli ulcer patients.

slots.claim_sentence: The Thogoto virus (THOV) ML protein regulates immune responses by engaging general transcription factor TFIIB.
slots.clarification_sentence: THOV is an orthomyxovirus.

slots.claim_sentence: TFIIB is critically important for the de novo recruitment of RNA polymerase II (Pol II).

slots.claim_sentence: TFIIB may not be required for regulated gene expression from paused promoters.
slots.clarification_sentence: Gene expression can be regulated through pausing of already recruited Pol II.

slots.claim_sentence: Targeting TFIIB by THOV affects immune responses.
slots.clarification_sentence: This mechanism keeps other cellular transcriptional activities intact.

slots.claim_sentence: Interference with TFIIB activity may be a favorable site for therapeutic intervention.
slots.clarification_sentence: This could help control undesirable inflammation.

slots.claim_sentence: Human parvovirus B19 (B19V) infection of primary human erythroid progenitor cells (EPCs) arrests infected cells at late S-phase and G2-phase.
slots.clarification_sentence: G2-phase is a point in the cell cycle where cells contain 4N DNA.

slots.claim_sentence: A C-terminal transactivation domain (TAD2) within the B19V NS1 protein is responsible for G2-phase arrest.
slots.clarification_sentence: The NS1 protein is a non-structural protein of B19V.

slots.claim_sentence: The study aimed to understand the mechanism of B19V NS1-induced G2-phase arrest.
slots.clarification_sentence: Researchers used doxycycline-inducible UT7/Epo-S1 cell lines expressing NS1 or NS1mTAD2.

slots.claim_sentence: The NS1 TAD2 domain plays a pivotal role in NS1-induced G2-phase arrest.
NS1 transactivated cellular gene expression through the TAD2 domain.
slots.clarification_sentence: This transactivation was responsible for ATR (ataxia-telangiectasia mutated and Rad3-related) activation.

slots.claim_sentence: Activated ATR phosphorylated CDC25C at serine 216.
slots.clarification_sentence: This phosphorylation inactivated the cyclin B/CDK1 complex.

slots.claim_sentence: The ATR-CHK1-CDC25C-CDK1 pathway was activated during B19V infection of EPCs.
slots.clarification_sentence: ATR activation played an important role in B19V infection-induced G2-phase arrest.

slots.claim_sentence: Severe dengue disease is characterized by vascular leak.
slots.clarification_sentence: Vascular leak is when fluid escapes from blood vessels.

slots.claim_sentence: Dengue virus nonstructural protein 1 (NS1) causes endothelial hyperpermeability.
slots.clarification_sentence: NS1 also disrupts the endothelial glycocalyx-like layer. The endothelial glycocalyx-like layer is a molecular barrier lining blood vessels.

slots.claim_sentence: This study examined how inflammatory mediators and endothelial cell pathways contribute to NS1-induced vascular leak.
DENV NS1, but not West Nile virus NS1, triggers localized vascular leak in mice.
slots.clarification_sentence: This was observed in the dorsal dermis of wild-type C57BL/6 mice.

slots.claim_sentence: Human dermal endothelial cells exposed to DENV NS1 do not produce inflammatory cytokines.
slots.clarification_sentence: Blocking these cytokines did not affect NS1-induced endothelial hyperpermeability.

slots.claim_sentence: DENV NS1 induces vascular leak in TLR4- or TNF-α receptor-deficient mice.
slots.clarification_sentence: The leak levels were similar to those in wild-type animals.

slots.claim_sentence: DENV NS1-induced vascular leak was blocked using inhibitors.
slots.clarification_sentence: These inhibitors target molecules involved in glycocalyx disruption. Inhibition of endothelial sialidases, cathepsin L, and heparanase prevented vascular leak.

slots.claim_sentence: DENV NS1-induced vascular leak is independent of inflammatory cytokines.
slots.clarification_sentence: The leak is dependent on endothelial glycocalyx components. These findings suggest potential targets for novel therapeutics.

slots.claim_sentence: Drug-resistant HIV is a major threat to the long-term effectiveness of antiretroviral treatment.
Around 10% of ART-naïve patients in Europe are infected with drug-resistant HIV type 1.
slots.clarification_sentence: ART-naïve patients have not received antiretroviral therapy.

slots.claim_sentence: This study used a phylodynamic approach to quantify the fitness costs of major resistance mutations.
slots.clarification_sentence: The study focused on the Swiss HIV cohort.

slots.claim_sentence: Fitness cost was quantified as the ratio of transmission rates between drug-resistant and drug-sensitive strains.
slots.clarification_sentence: A lower ratio indicates a fitness cost for the resistant strain.

slots.claim_sentence: Only the 90M mutation in the protease gene had significantly higher fitness than drug-sensitive strains.
slots.clarification_sentence: This suggests the 90M mutation might give the virus an advantage in spreading.

slots.claim_sentence: Mutations 67N, 70R, 184V, and 219Q were less fit than sensitive strains.
slots.clarification_sentence: These mutations are associated with resistance to reverse transcriptase inhibitors.

slots.claim_sentence: Other resistance mutations did not significantly affect viral transmissibility within the Swiss HIV cohort.
slots.clarification_sentence: These mutations did not significantly increase or decrease the virus's ability to spread.

slots.claim_sentence: The study developed and validated a novel phylodynamic approach.
slots.clarification_sentence: This approach estimates the transmission fitness cost of drug resistance mutations.

slots.claim_sentence: The pathophysiological mechanisms of leprosy are still incompletely understood.
slots.clarification_sentence: Leprosy is an urgent public health issue in Brazil.

slots.claim_sentence: Complement receptor 1 (CR1) facilitates the entry of mycobacteria into macrophages.
slots.clarification_sentence: CR1 binds to complement fragments C3b/C4b on the bacteria.

slots.claim_sentence: This case-control study investigated CR1 polymorphisms, gene expression, and soluble CR1 levels.
slots.clarification_sentence: The study aimed to understand CR1's role in leprosy susceptibility in Brazilian patients.

slots.claim_sentence: Nine CR1 polymorphisms were genotyped in 213 leprosy patients and 297 controls.
slots.clarification_sentence: mRNA and soluble CR1 (sCR1) levels were measured in a subset of samples.

slots.claim_sentence: Individuals with a common recombinant CR1 haplotype showed twice the susceptibility to leprosy.
slots.clarification_sentence: This haplotype included rs3849266*T and rs3737002*T, encoding p.1408Met of the York Yka+ antigen.

slots.claim_sentence: Paucibacillary leprosy patients with these CR1 variants exhibited lower soluble CR1 (sCR1) levels.
slots.clarification_sentence: Lower sCR1 levels are associated with a reduced anti-inflammatory response.

slots.claim_sentence: The most ancient CR1 haplotype increased susceptibility to the multibacillary clinical form of leprosy.
This ancient haplotype included the intronic rs12034383*G allele.
slots.clarification_sentence: This allele was associated with higher CR1 gene expression, potentially increasing parasite internalization.

slots.claim_sentence: The study suggests CR1 polymorphisms regulate mRNA and soluble CR1 levels.
slots.clarification_sentence: Haplotype-specific effects increase leprosy susceptibility, possibly by enhancing parasite phagocytosis and inflammation.

slots.claim_sentence: Cells in the Drosophila retina have specific shapes that develop during tissue formation.

slots.clarification_sentence: This simulation minimizes the global interfacial energy between cells.

slots.claim_sentence: A simple model can explain experimental data for normal and mutant cells.

slots.claim_sentence: The simulations accurately reproduce the geometries of both wild-type and mutant cells.
The simulations distinguish features of cadherin dynamics.
The simulations emphasize the importance of adhesion protein biogenesis and its timing for cell remodeling.
The simulations suggest that N-cadherin protein is recycled from inactive to active interfaces.
slots.clarification_sentence: This recycling modulates adhesion strengths between cells.

slots.claim_sentence: Feedback regulation of cell lineage progression helps maintain tissue size homeostasis.
slots.clarification_sentence: Its role in tissue morphogenesis is not yet understood.

slots.claim_sentence: Mathematical modeling was used to study a specific feedback architecture.
slots.clarification_sentence: This architecture involves positive and negative diffusible signals acting on stem or progenitor cells.

slots.claim_sentence: This feedback architecture leads to bistable or bi-modal growth behaviors.
slots.clarification_sentence: It also causes ultrasensitivity to external growth cues and local growth-driven budding.

slots.claim_sentence: The architecture triggers self-sustaining elongation and self-organization.
slots.clarification_sentence: This self-organization appears as lamellar fingers.

slots.claim_sentence: These behaviors arise from controlling stem or progenitor self-renewal.
slots.clarification_sentence: They do not arise from regulating cell cycle speeds.

slots.claim_sentence: Spatial patterns result from interactions between diffusible factors with antagonistic effects.
slots.clarification_sentence: However, morphogenesis is not a consequence of Turing-type instabilities.

slots.claim_sentence: Pattern formation is driven by the coupling between tissue growth and system ultrasensitivity.
slots.clarification_sentence: Pattern formation is not driven by intrinsic differences in spatial ranges of signals.

slots.claim_sentence: About half of mitochondrial DNA (mtDNA) mutations causing diseases in humans occur in tRNA genes.
Pathogenic tRNA mutations can reach homoplasmy and show different penetrance among patients.
slots.clarification_sentence: Homoplasmy means all mitochondrial DNA copies in a cell are mutant.

slots.claim_sentence: This study generated the first mitochondrial tRNA pathological mutation in mouse cells.
slots.clarification_sentence: The mutation is an m.3739G>A transition in the mitochondrial mt-Ti gene.

slots.claim_sentence: The mouse mutation recapitulates molecular hallmarks of a human disease-causing mutation.
slots.clarification_sentence: This human mutation is an m.4290T>C transition affecting the human mt-Ti gene.

slots.claim_sentence: The pathogenic mechanism for both mouse and human mutations is abnormal folding of tRNAIle.
slots.clarification_sentence: This abnormal folding prevents tRNAIle from being charged with isoleucine. Isoleucine is an amino acid essential for protein synthesis.

slots.claim_sentence: Cells with mutant tRNA show increased mitochondrial biogenesis.
slots.clarification_sentence: This is triggered by higher mitochondrial ROS production as a compensatory response.

slots.claim_sentence: The combination of the pathogenic and compensatory mechanisms can explain the mutation's penetrance pattern.
slots.clarification_sentence: The compensatory response can be sufficient to offset the mutation's deleterious effect.

slots.claim_sentence: Horizontal acquisition of DNA by bacteria increases genetic diversity.
slots.clarification_sentence: This helps bacteria colonize various niches, including human hosts.

slots.claim_sentence: The global modulator H-NS targets both core genome and horizontally acquired genes (HGT genes).
slots.clarification_sentence: H-NS silences gene expression in response to external stimuli like osmolarity and temperature.

slots.claim_sentence: The study shows that H-NS discriminates and differentially modulates core and HGT DNA.
slots.clarification_sentence: This differential modulation allows bacteria to manage diverse genetic material.

slots.claim_sentence: Plasmid R27-encoded H-NS protein selectively silences HGT genes.
slots.clarification_sentence: This H-NS protein does not interfere with core genome regulation.

slots.claim_sentence: Differential regulation of gene lineages by chromosomal H-NS requires the helper protein Hha.
slots.clarification_sentence: Hha assists chromosomal H-NS in distinguishing between gene types.

slots.claim_sentence: Tight silencing of HGT DNA is accomplished by H-NS-Hha complexes.
slots.clarification_sentence: These complexes ensure efficient suppression of acquired genetic material.

slots.claim_sentence: Core genes are modulated by H-NS homoligomers.
slots.clarification_sentence: H-NS homoligomers regulate the essential genes of the bacteria.

slots.claim_sentence: Hha-like proteins are restricted to the Enterobacteriaceae.
slots.clarification_sentence: This suggests a specialized regulatory mechanism in this bacterial family.

slots.claim_sentence: The ability to discriminate between core and HGT DNA may maintain acquired DNA in a silent form.
slots.clarification_sentence: This gives bacteria a competitive advantage in adapting to new environments and host colonization.

slots.claim_sentence: The PR interval on an electrocardiogram reflects the conduction time in the atria and atrioventricular node of the heart.
Genome-wide association (GWA) studies have identified genetic determinants of the PR interval in European and Asian populations.
slots.clarification_sentence: However, there is a general lack of GWA studies in individuals of African ancestry.

slots.claim_sentence: The study performed GWA studies in 6,247 African American individuals from four cohorts.
slots.clarification_sentence: The goal was to identify genetic variants associated with PR interval duration.

slots.claim_sentence: A strong genetic signal (rs3922844) was found within the SCN5A gene.
slots.clarification_sentence: The SCN5A gene encodes the cardiac sodium channel and showed a genome-wide significant association with PR interval in African Americans.

slots.claim_sentence: The identified SNP (rs3922844) in SCN5A explained 2% of PR interval variability in African Americans.
The SNP rs3922844 was also associated with PR interval in individuals of European ancestry.
slots.clarification_sentence: However, it had a smaller effect size and explained 0.5% of variability compared to African Americans.

slots.claim_sentence: Further meta-analysis identified genome-wide significant associations with SNPs in SCN10A, MEIS1, and TBX5.
slots.clarification_sentence: These SNPs were highly correlated with SNPs previously identified in European and Asian GWA studies.

slots.claim_sentence: The findings demonstrate the relevance of common genetic variants to African Americans at four loci.
slots.clarification_sentence: These loci were previously associated with PR interval in European and Asian samples, and SCN5A showed a stronger association in African Americans.

slots.claim_sentence: Many U.S.-bound refugees come from countries where intestinal parasites are common.
slots.clarification_sentence: These parasites include hookworm, Trichuris trichiura, Ascaris lumbricoides, and Strongyloides stercoralis.

slots.claim_sentence: Intestinal parasite infections are rare in the United States.
slots.clarification_sentence: These infections may be underdiagnosed or misdiagnosed, leading to serious health consequences.

slots.claim_sentence: This study evaluated the costs and benefits of different strategies for managing parasitic diseases in U.S.-bound refugees.
slots.clarification_sentence: Strategies included overseas presumptive treatment, domestic screening and treatment, or no program.

slots.claim_sentence: An economic decision tree model was developed to estimate the cost and health impacts.
slots.clarification_sentence: The model used Markov processes for an annual cohort of 27,700 U.S.-bound Asian refugees.

slots.claim_sentence: The "Overseas Albendazole and Ivermectin" option was less expensive than other strategies.
slots.clarification_sentence: These included "Domestic Screening and Treatment" or "Overseas Albendazole and Domestic Screening for Strongyloides."

slots.claim_sentence: The most effective treatment option was "Overseas Albendazole and Ivermectin."
slots.clarification_sentence: This option reduced outpatient cases, deaths, and hospitalizations by about 80% compared to "No Program."

slots.claim_sentence: Overseas presumptive treatment for U.S.-bound refugees is a cost-effective intervention.
slots.clarification_sentence: It is less expensive and at least as effective as domestic screening and treatment programs.

slots.claim_sentence: Adding ivermectin to albendazole treatment reduces chronic strongyloidiasis.
slots.clarification_sentence: This also lowers the risk of potentially fatal disseminated strongyloidiasis.

slots.claim_sentence: Cryptococcus neoformans is a fungus that causes fungal meningitis worldwide.
slots.clarification_sentence: This pathogen is responsible for hundreds of thousands of deaths annually.

slots.claim_sentence: Cryptococcal glycans are required for fungal survival in the host.
slots.clarification_sentence: Glycans are also necessary for the fungus to cause disease.

slots.claim_sentence: Nucleotide sugar transporters are membrane proteins.
slots.clarification_sentence: These transporters exchange nucleotide sugars for nucleoside phosphates. They move activated sugar precursors from the cytosol to the secretory pathway.

slots.claim_sentence: Xylose is a significant capsule component in C. neoformans.
slots.clarification_sentence: Xylose is a neutral monosaccharide not found in model yeast. C. neoformans extensively uses xylose in capsule polysaccharides.

slots.claim_sentence: Uxt1 and Uxt2 are transporters specific for the xylose donor, UDP-xylose.
slots.clarification_sentence: These are the first identified fungal UDP-xylose transporters.

slots.claim_sentence: Uxt1 and Uxt2 also transport the galactofuranose donor, UDP-galactofuranose.
Uxt1 and Uxt2 are necessary for C. neoformans to cause disease in mice.
slots.clarification_sentence: These transporters are required for xylose incorporation into capsule and protein. Loss of both proteins results in complete loss of xylose from the capsule.

slots.claim_sentence: The elucidated synthetic pathway may be productively targeted for therapy.
slots.clarification_sentence: These findings contribute to understanding fundamental glycobiology.

slots.claim_sentence: Chronic helminth infections induce a Th2 immune shift and establish an immunoregulatory environment.

slots.clarification_sentence: Th1 immunity is necessary for MTB control and can be suppressed by helminth-induced responses.

slots.claim_sentence: Co-infection studies were conducted in cotton rats.
slots.clarification_sentence: Cotton rats are the natural host for the filarial nematode Litomosoides sigmodontis and model human MTB.

slots.claim_sentence: Immunological responses, histological studies, and quantitative mycobacterial cultures were assessed.
slots.clarification_sentence: These assessments were done in cotton rats with and without chronic L. sigmodontis infection.

slots.claim_sentence: Spleen cell proliferation and interferon gamma production were similar between co-infected and MTB-only infected cotton rats.
slots.clarification_sentence: These responses were measured in response to purified protein derivative.

slots.claim_sentence: MTB loads and the occurrence and size of lung granulomas were not increased in co-infected cotton rats.
slots.clarification_sentence: This finding was contrary to the initial hypothesis.

slots.claim_sentence: Chronic filaria infections do not exacerbate MTB infection in the cotton rat model.
It may be possible to develop worm-derived therapies for autoimmune diseases.
slots.clarification_sentence: These therapies would not substantially increase the risk for infections.

slots.claim_sentence: Conventional activation markers did not correlate with iNKT cell effector function during Mtb infection.
slots.clarification_sentence: iNKT cell control of Mtb replication was also independent of TNF and cell-mediated cytotoxicity.

slots.claim_sentence: The study identified GM-CSF as a novel mediator of iNKT cell antimicrobial activity.

slots.clarification_sentence: GM-CSF was produced by iNKT cells in vitro and in vivo.

slots.claim_sentence: GM-CSF production is a novel iNKT cell antimicrobial effector function.
slots.clarification_sentence: This suggests a potential role for GM-CSF in T cell immunity against Mtb.

slots.claim_sentence: The ability of genetic variants to predict gene expression in unseen individuals has rarely been evaluated.
An algorithm was devised to predict gene expression in unseen individuals.
slots.clarification_sentence: The algorithm uses only genotype information from the local genomic vicinity of the predicted gene. The method uses multiple genetic variants to explain variation in gene expression.

slots.claim_sentence: The algorithm's predictions are robust.
slots.clarification_sentence: Predictions agreed well between training and test sets, even across distinct populations.

slots.claim_sentence: The number of genes that can be predicted is relatively small.
slots.clarification_sentence: The robust nature of the predictions means their identity and quantitative degree are known in advance.

slots.claim_sentence: An extension of the algorithm incorporates genomic annotations.
slots.clarification_sentence: This extension differentially weighs genetic variants, improving predictions by assigning higher weights to specific annotations. Proximity to genes and high regional G/C content are examples of such annotations.

slots.claim_sentence: Successfully predicted genes have higher expression and more variability across individuals.
slots.clarification_sentence: This provides insight into the characteristics of predictable genes.

slots.claim_sentence: Machupo virus (MACV) causes Bolivian hemorrhagic fever (BHF).
A recombinant MACV (rMACV/Cd#1-GPC) with glycoprotein from the Candid#1 (Cd#1) vaccine strain of Junin virus (JUNV) was fully attenuated in mice.
slots.clarification_sentence: This rMACV also protected animals from lethal MACV challenge.

slots.claim_sentence: A mutation in the transmembrane domain (TMD) alone was not enough to fully attenuate JUNV.
slots.clarification_sentence: This suggested that other glycoprotein (GPC) domains also contribute to attenuation.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers created several recombinant MACVs (rMACVs) to study which parts of the Cd#1 GPC are needed for MACV attenuation.
slots.clarification_sentence: These included MCg1 (ectodomain only), MCg2 (ectodomain plus TMD F438I mutation), and MCg3 (ectodomain plus Cd#1 TMD).

slots.claim_sentence: In mice, the MCg1 virus showed a significant reduction in lethality compared to the original rMACV.
slots.clarification_sentence: The MCg1 virus contained only the ectodomain of Cd#1 GPC.

slots.claim_sentence: The MCg1 virus was detected in the brains and spleens of infected mice.
slots.clarification_sentence: This infection caused tissue inflammation.

slots.claim_sentence: All mice infected with MCg2 and MCg3 survived.
slots.clarification_sentence: These mice had no detectable virus in their organs and produced neutralizing antibodies against Cd#1.

slots.claim_sentence: The findings suggest that each domain of the glycoprotein (GPC) plays a crucial role in fully attenuating rMACV/Cd#1 GPC.
slots.clarification_sentence: Each GPC domain also contributes to its immunogenicity.

slots.claim_sentence: A general method was established for reversible and inducible gene knockout and rescue in mice.
This system, named iKO, allows the target gene to be turned on and off by treating mice with doxycycline.
slots.clarification_sentence: The system minimizes embryonic lethality, developmental effects, and compensatory effects.

slots.claim_sentence: The iKO method combines two genetically modified mouse lines.
slots.clarification_sentence: One line has a tetracycline-dependent transactivator replacing the target gene, and the other has a tetracycline-inducible cDNA inserted into a TIGRE genomic locus. The TIGRE locus provides for low basal expression and high inducibility.

slots.claim_sentence: A method was developed to easily introduce genes into the TIGRE site of mouse embryonic stem (ES) cells.
slots.clarification_sentence: This was done using recombinase-mediated insertion. The TIGRE locus occurs infrequently in the genome.

slots.claim_sentence: Both KO and TIGRE lines were engineered for high-throughput, large-scale, and cost-effective production of iKO mice.
As a proof of concept, iKO mice were created in the apolipoprotein E (ApoE) gene.
slots.clarification_sentence: The ApoE gene allows for sensitive and quantitative phenotypic analyses.

slots.claim_sentence: The iKO system demonstrated reversible switching of ApoE transcription and plasma cholesterol levels.
slots.clarification_sentence: It also showed reversible atherosclerosis progression and regression. These on/off switches occurred rapidly.

slots.claim_sentence: The iKO system shows stringent regulation and is a versatile genetic system.
slots.clarification_sentence: It can incorporate other techniques and adapt to a wide range of applications. The system is applicable to any gene in any tissue.
