slots.claim_sentence: The interaction and integration of multiple coding mechanisms in neural circuits are not well understood.
The locust olfactory system transforms dense spike trains in the antenna lobe (AL) into a sparse representation in the mushroom body (MB).
slots.clarification_sentence: The mushroom body is a region associated with memory.

slots.claim_sentence: In vivo recordings from the insect mushroom body (MB) showed highly specific responses to odors in Kenyon cells (KCs).
slots.clarification_sentence: Kenyon cells are neurons within the mushroom body.

slots.claim_sentence: Only a few Kenyon cells (KCs) responded reliably to a specific odor.
The study explored whether plasticity controls synaptic weights of inputs to the mushroom body (MB).
slots.clarification_sentence: This control would ensure the specificity of Kenyon cell (KC) responses to familiar odors.

slots.claim_sentence: Plasticity at the synapses between the antenna lobe (AL) and the mushroom body (MB) regulated tuning.
slots.clarification_sentence: This tuning filtered intense AL output and condensed it to a sparse representation in the MB.

slots.claim_sentence: Activity-dependent plasticity drove the specificity, reliability, and persistence of odor representations.
slots.clarification_sentence: This suggests a role for plasticity in information processing.

slots.claim_sentence: Leptospirosis is a zoonotic disease found worldwide.
slots.clarification_sentence: It is caused by a spirochete bacterium.

slots.claim_sentence: Wild rodents, including the brown rat, are main reservoirs of Leptospira.
slots.clarification_sentence: Leptospira infection is asymptomatic in these animals.

slots.claim_sentence: Understanding rat-rat transmission of Leptospira requires using natural inoculation routes.
slots.clarification_sentence: These include mucosal or subcutaneous routes.

slots.claim_sentence: This study investigated subcutaneous and mucosal inoculation routes in adult rats.
slots.clarification_sentence: The routes were compared to the intraperitoneal route during Leptospira infection.

slots.claim_sentence: Leptospira infection was asymptomatic in rats regardless of the inoculation route.
slots.clarification_sentence: The infection caused similar antibody production.

slots.claim_sentence: Renal colonization rates varied by inoculation route.
slots.clarification_sentence: Intraperitoneal infection resulted in 8 out of 8 rats colonized, mucosal in 5 out of 8, and subcutaneous in 1 out of 8.

slots.claim_sentence: Mucosal inoculation was more efficient for renal colonization than the subcutaneous route.
slots.clarification_sentence: It was also associated with urinary excretion and induced a slower infection than the intraperitoneal route.

slots.claim_sentence: Antibody production was similar across all inoculation routes.
These results facilitate understanding Leptospira infection modalities in rats.
slots.clarification_sentence: The findings differ from epidemiological studies in wild rats.

slots.claim_sentence: Spinal cord injury (SCI) is a devastating condition with no available treatments.
Stem cells show promise for restoring neurological function.
This study used systematic review, meta-analysis, and meta-regression to examine stem cell treatments in animal models of SCI.
Allogeneic stem cell treatment generally improved both motor and sensory outcomes in animal models of SCI.
slots.clarification_sentence: Allogeneic stem cells are cells from a donor. The study included data from 312 comparisons for motor outcomes.

slots.claim_sentence: For sensory outcomes, differences between experiments were largely explained by aspects of stem cell biology.
Differentiation of stem cells before implantation and intravenous delivery led to better sensory outcomes.
slots.clarification_sentence: Differentiation means the stem cells matured into specific cell types.

slots.claim_sentence: Most variability in motor outcomes was explained by experimental modeling and the outcome measure used.
slots.clarification_sentence: The location of injury and method of injury induction had an impact.

slots.claim_sentence: Studies of motor outcomes that did not use blinded assessment reported inflated estimates of efficacy.
slots.clarification_sentence: Blinded assessment means researchers did not know which animals received treatment.

slots.claim_sentence: While preclinical literature suggests promise for stem-cell therapies, their actual efficacy is likely lower.
slots.clarification_sentence: This is due to compromised internal validity and publication bias.

slots.claim_sentence: This study investigated insulin signaling in the growth, development, sexual maturation, and egg production of adult schistosomes.
slots.clarification_sentence: Researchers focused on the insulin receptors (SjIRs) of Schistosoma japonicum.

slots.claim_sentence: Biolayer Interferometry showed that human insulin binds to the L1 subdomain of recombinant SjIR1 and SjIR2.
slots.clarification_sentence: These subdomains are also called SjLD1 and SjLD2. This binding activates the parasite's insulin pathway. The binding regulates transcription of downstream genes.

slots.claim_sentence: RNA interference (RNAi) was used to reduce SjIR expression in adult S. japonicum in vitro.
slots.clarification_sentence: This reduced transcription of SjIRs and other genes in the insulin pathway. These genes are associated with glucose metabolism and schistosome fecundity.

slots.claim_sentence: SjIR-knockdown worms showed a significant decrease in glucose uptake.
slots.clarification_sentence: This was observed when compared to luciferase controls. Glucose uptake is vital for parasite survival and energy.

slots.claim_sentence: Vaccine/challenge experiments in mice showed that recombinant SjLD1 and SjLD2 depressed female growth.
slots.clarification_sentence: These also reduced intestinal granuloma density and faecal egg production in S. japonicum-infected mice.

slots.claim_sentence: These findings highlight the potential of SjIRs as veterinary transmission-blocking vaccine candidates.
slots.clarification_sentence: This applies against zoonotic schistosomiasis japonica in China and the Philippines.

slots.claim_sentence: Hybridization between humans and Neanderthals resulted in a low level of Neanderthal ancestry scattered across the genomes of many modern-day humans.
After hybridization, selection appears to have removed Neanderthal alleles from the human population on average.
The researchers developed a novel method to estimate the genome-wide average strength of selection and the density of selected sites.
slots.clarification_sentence: This method used estimates of Neanderthal allele frequency along the genomes of modern-day humans.

slots.claim_sentence: East Asians had somewhat higher initial levels of Neanderthal ancestry than Europeans, even after accounting for selection.
The bulk of purifying selection against Neanderthal ancestry is best understood as acting on many weakly deleterious alleles.
slots.clarification_sentence: Purifying selection removes harmful genetic variations from a population.

slots.claim_sentence: The majority of these alleles were effectively neutral and segregating at high frequency in Neanderthals.
slots.clarification_sentence: These alleles became selected against after entering human populations of much larger effective size.

slots.claim_sentence: Individually, these alleles had a small effect but potentially imposed a heavy genetic load on early-generation human-Neanderthal hybrids.
Differences in effective population size may play a more important role in shaping levels of introgression than previously thought.

slots.claim_sentence: Many human transcription factors form structure only upon target binding.
This study investigates the folding and binding of the pKID domain of CREB to the KIX domain of the co-activator CBP.
slots.clarification_sentence: CREB is a transcription factor and CBP is a co-activator.

slots.claim_sentence: Simulations predict a coupled folding and binding mechanism for pKID and KIX.
slots.clarification_sentence: The simulations also predict the existence of partially bound intermediates.

slots.claim_sentence: The binding transition state for pKID and KIX resembles the unstructured state in solution.
slots.clarification_sentence: This suggests CREB becomes structured only after committing to binding.

slots.claim_sentence: The mechanism where structure changes after binding is similar to an induced-fit mechanism.
slots.clarification_sentence: This contrasts with models where binding occurs to pre-structured conformations.

slots.claim_sentence: Increasing the amount of structure in the unbound pKID reduces the rate of binding.
slots.clarification_sentence: This suggests a 'fly-casting'-like process.

slots.claim_sentence: The study helps explain how being unstructured can provide an advantage in protein target recognition.
slots.clarification_sentence: Many proteins involved in cell signaling have unstructured regions.

slots.claim_sentence: The simulations are generally consistent with a nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) study.
slots.clarification_sentence: The simulations also aid in interpreting experimental binding kinetics.

slots.claim_sentence: Francisella tularensis (Ft) is a highly infectious Gram-negative bacterium that causes the human disease tularemia.
Three enzymes, FlmF1, FlmF2, and FlmK, modify Francisella novicida (Fn) lipid A carbohydrate.
slots.clarification_sentence: These enzymes add mannose, galactosamine, or both carbohydrates to the lipid A.

slots.claim_sentence: Fn mutants lacking galactosamine (flmF2) or both galactosamine and mannose (flmK) were attenuated in mice.
slots.clarification_sentence: These mutants were less virulent when given through pulmonary and subcutaneous routes.

slots.claim_sentence: Aerosolization of flmF2 and flmK mutants protected against wild-type Fn challenge.
slots.clarification_sentence: Only the flmK mutant provided protection when administered subcutaneously.

slots.claim_sentence: The flmK mutant induced higher levels of tumor necrosis factor-α (TNF-α) and macrophage inhibitory protein-2 (MIP-2).
slots.clarification_sentence: This occurred in an alveolar macrophage cell line compared to wild-type Fn.

slots.claim_sentence: Bone marrow–derived macrophages (BMMø) from TLR4 and TLR2/4 knockout mice produced more IL-6 and MIP-2.
slots.clarification_sentence: This was seen when infected with the flmK mutant compared to wild-type Fn.

slots.claim_sentence: IL-6 and MIP-2 were undetectable in BMMø from MyD88−/− mice infected with either strain.
The flmK mutant's ability to activate pro-inflammatory cytokine/chemokine production and innate immune responses causes its attenuation.
slots.clarification_sentence: This activation occurs via the MyD88 signaling pathway and leads to protective immunity.

slots.claim_sentence: Escape mutant (EM) virus frequently appears after HIV-1 or SIV infection.

slots.claim_sentence: Infection with mixes containing at least 10% WT virus led to rapid outgrowth of WT virus.

slots.claim_sentence: In contrast, infection with SHIVmn229 viruses with smaller WT proportions showed delayed reversion.
slots.clarification_sentence: A molecular clone of pure EM SIVmac239 also showed a slow reversion pattern.

slots.claim_sentence: WT virus was not detectable until at least 8 days after inoculation in delayed cases.
slots.clarification_sentence: It took at least 8 weeks to become the dominant quasispecies.

slots.clarification_sentence: This timing in turn predicts the outcome of infection.

slots.claim_sentence: Delayed reversion of fitness-reducing escape mutations suggests opportunities to reduce HIV pathogenicity.

slots.claim_sentence: Most dengue virus (DENV) infections are subclinical, but type-cross-reactive immunity can affect the outcome of subsequent infections.
slots.clarification_sentence: Subclinical means having mild or no symptoms.

slots.claim_sentence: The mechanisms that control different clinical outcomes of DENV infection are not well understood.
Blood samples were collected from school-aged Thai children who later experienced either subclinical DENV infection or developed dengue illness.
Peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMC) collected before infection were stimulated with DENV in vitro.
slots.clarification_sentence: The secretion of 30 cytokines, which are immune signaling proteins, was then measured.

slots.claim_sentence: Secretion of IL-15 and MCP-1 was significantly higher in PBMC from subjects who later developed symptomatic DENV infection.
IL-6 was produced by PBMC from all subjects who developed symptomatic infection.
slots.clarification_sentence: This compared to 59% of subjects with subclinical infection.

slots.claim_sentence: Secretion of IL-12, IL-2R, MIP-1α, RANTES, GM-CSF, and TNFα was significantly lower in PBMC from subjects with symptomatic infection.
The varying levels of cytokines in symptomatic versus subclinical infection suggest both protective and pathologic immune profiles exist.
Clinical-immunological correlations identified in natural DENV infection may be useful for evaluating immune responses to dengue vaccines.

slots.claim_sentence: Polygenic type 2 diabetes in mouse models is linked to obesity.
slots.clarification_sentence: This condition results from a combination of adipogenic and diabetogenic alleles.

slots.claim_sentence: The study identified a candidate gene for the diabetogenic effect of a QTL called Nidd/SJL.
slots.clarification_sentence: This QTL was contributed by SJL, NON, and NZB strains in outcross populations with New Zealand Obese (NZO) mice.

slots.claim_sentence: A critical interval of distal chromosome 4 (2.1 Mbp) was identified.
slots.clarification_sentence: This interval confers the diabetic phenotype.

slots.claim_sentence: Analysis of 10 genes in the critical interval revealed allelic variance of Zfp69.
slots.clarification_sentence: Zfp69 encodes zinc finger domain transcription factor 69.

slots.claim_sentence: In NZO and C57BL/6J mice, a retrotransposon (IAPLTR1a) disrupted the Zfp69 gene.
slots.clarification_sentence: This disruption led to a truncated mRNA lacking coding sequences for KRAB and Znf-C2H2 domains.

slots.claim_sentence: The diabetogenic Zfp69SJL allele produced hyperglycaemia when combined with the B6.V-Lepob background.
slots.clarification_sentence: It also reduced gonadal fat and increased plasma and liver triglycerides.

slots.claim_sentence: Zfp69 is the most likely candidate for the diabetogenic effect of Nidd/SJL.
slots.clarification_sentence: Retrotransposon IAPLTR1a contributes to the genetic heterogeneity of mouse strains.

slots.claim_sentence: Expression of the transcription factor Zfp69 in adipose tissue may play a role in type 2 diabetes.

slots.claim_sentence: Alternative cell differentiation pathways arise from signaling pathways and transcriptional regulatory networks.
Predicting mammalian cell differentiation from specific signals and transcriptional factors is challenging.
Researchers developed an integrated model of regulatory networks and signaling pathways.
slots.clarification_sentence: This model controls T-helper (Th) cell differentiation. The model aims to understand how T-helper cells differentiate.

slots.claim_sentence: The model used a logical formalism for dynamical analyses.
slots.clarification_sentence: This was necessary because most available data were qualitative. A logical formalism is a discrete modeling framework.

slots.claim_sentence: A model reduction approach and a stable state identification algorithm managed network complexity.
slots.clarification_sentence: The full network was too large for direct analysis.

slots.claim_sentence: Systematic simulations assessed how heterogeneous environments affect Th cell differentiation.
slots.clarification_sentence: Simulations determined how naive Th cells differentiate into specialized cells.

slots.claim_sentence: Simulations identified stable states for canonical Th1, Th2, Th17, and Treg subtypes.
slots.clarification_sentence: These coexisted with transient hybrid cell types expressing combinations of markers in an environment-dependent way. Hybrid cell types express markers of two or more canonical cell types.

slots.claim_sentence: The logical analysis clarified the nature of these hybrid cell types.
slots.clarification_sentence: It also showed their relationships with canonical Th subtypes.

slots.claim_sentence: The logical model can explore novel differentiation pathways in silico.

slots.claim_sentence: Eukaryotic protein kinases regulate most cellular functions by phosphorylating targeted protein substrates.
slots.clarification_sentence: These kinases use a highly conserved catalytic core for this process.

slots.claim_sentence: The catalytic core of eukaryotic protein kinases oscillates between open, intermediate, and closed conformations.
slots.clarification_sentence: This oscillation occurs when the kinase is in its active state.

slots.claim_sentence: The intramolecular interactions that regulate the active state mechanics of these kinases are not well understood.
This study used cAMP-dependent protein kinase as a model.
slots.clarification_sentence: The research defined a set of electrostatic and hydrophobic interactions that regulate the active state mechanics.

slots.claim_sentence: The identified interactions include a salt bridge between a lysine from the β3-strand and a glutamate from the αC-helix.
slots.clarification_sentence: Other interactions are an electrostatic interaction between the phosphorylated activation loop and αC-helix, and hydrophobic residues of the Regulatory spine and Shell.

slots.claim_sentence: The β3-lysine is not required for phosphoryl transfer.
slots.clarification_sentence: This finding contradicts a long-held belief, as the β3-lysine is essential for the active state mechanics of eukaryotic protein kinases.

slots.claim_sentence: SUVH9 and IDN2 are components of an RNA-directed DNA methylation (RdDM) pathway in Arabidopsis.
slots.clarification_sentence: The RdDM pathway mediates de novo DNA methylation.

slots.claim_sentence: SUVH9 interacts with MORC6, but its role in transcriptional silencing was unknown.
slots.clarification_sentence: Transcriptional silencing is a process that turns off gene expression.

slots.claim_sentence: Genetic analysis shows that SUVH2 and SUVH9 work with MORC6 to mediate transcriptional silencing.
slots.clarification_sentence: They can act in the same pathway or synergistically with MORC6.

slots.claim_sentence: IDN2 interacts with MORC6 and mediates silencing at some MORC6 target loci.
slots.clarification_sentence: IDN2 also acts as a component in the RdDM pathway.

slots.claim_sentence: MORC6 mediates transcriptional silencing through heterochromatin condensation.
slots.clarification_sentence: Heterochromatin condensation is a process where DNA is tightly packed.

slots.claim_sentence: SWI3B, SWI3C, and SWI3D interact with MORC6 and SUVH9.
slots.clarification_sentence: These SWI/SNF chromatin-remodeling complex components mediate transcriptional silencing.

slots.claim_sentence: RdDM components are involved in DNA methylation and MORC6-mediated heterochromatin condensation.
slots.clarification_sentence: SUVH2/9 and IDN2 cooperate with MORC6 in transcriptional silencing.

slots.claim_sentence: DNA methylation is linked to heterochromatin condensation.
slots.clarification_sentence: This linkage enhances transcriptional silencing at methylated genomic regions.

slots.claim_sentence: Apparent motion (AM) is an illusory perception where two stimuli presented alternately at different locations evoke continuous movement.
The neural mechanism for AM is thought to be increased activation of primary visual cortex (V1) neurons.
slots.clarification_sentence: However, evidence for this increased activation remains inconclusive.

slots.claim_sentence: AM masking, a reduced detectability of stimuli along the AM path, has been taken as evidence for V1 activation.
Predictive coding models can also explain AM masking by predicting suppressed responses to stimuli on the AM path.
slots.clarification_sentence: This suppression occurs when stimuli match the spatio-temporal prediction of a moving stimulus.

slots.claim_sentence: This study found that AM affects target grating detection, limiting maximum performance at high contrast levels.
AM masking is strongest when the target orientation is identical to the orientation of the inducers.
The researchers developed a V1-like population code model of early visual processing.
slots.clarification_sentence: This model was based on a standard contrast normalization model.

slots.claim_sentence: The model predicts that AM-related activation in early visual cortex is too small to cause masking.
slots.clarification_sentence: This activation is also too small to be perceived as motion.

slots.claim_sentence: The model instead predicts strong suppression of early sensory responses during AM.
slots.clarification_sentence: This finding is consistent with the theoretical framework of predictive coding.

slots.claim_sentence: Propagule pressure, the number of individuals introduced to found a population, consistently determines the establishment success of alien species.
This study used Bayesian meta-analytical methods for the first quantitative systematic review of this relationship.
slots.clarification_sentence: A quantitative systematic review combines and analyzes data from multiple studies.

slots.claim_sentence: The relationship between propagule pressure and establishment success was evaluated across many taxa and life histories.
slots.clarification_sentence: These included invertebrates, herbaceous plants, long-lived trees, and terrestrial and aquatic vertebrates.

slots.claim_sentence: A positive mean effect of propagule pressure on establishment success was found for every hypothesis tested.
slots.clarification_sentence: Higher propagule pressure generally led to greater establishment success.

slots.claim_sentence: Establishment success depended most critically on propagule pressures in the range of 10–100 individuals.
Differences in effect size were mainly linked to various analytical approaches.
slots.clarification_sentence: There was also some evidence of larger effect sizes in animal introductions compared to plant introductions.

slots.claim_sentence: The scale of study or methodology used did not account for any variation in effect size.
slots.clarification_sentence: This included studies from field to global scales, and observational, experimental, or proxy methods.

slots.claim_sentence: The analyses showed remarkable consistency in the relationship between propagule pressure and alien population establishment success.

slots.claim_sentence: Mathematical modeling and sensitivity analysis can computationally screen mechanistic models of human cascades for points of fragility.
slots.clarification_sentence: These sensitive mechanisms could serve as therapeutic targets.

slots.claim_sentence: The study tested this hypothesis by screening a mathematical model of the coagulation cascade.
The coagulation cascade model included 92 proteins and 148 protein-protein interactions.
slots.clarification_sentence: The model was validated using 21 published datasets from in vitro coagulation models.

slots.claim_sentence: Simulated platelet activation and thrombin generation profiles were consistent with measured values.
slots.clarification_sentence: The model showed a mean correlation of 0.87 across all trials.

slots.claim_sentence: Overall state sensitivity coefficients were calculated using a Monte Carlo strategy.
slots.clarification_sentence: These coefficients measure the robustness or fragility of a given mechanism.

slots.claim_sentence: In the absence of anticoagulants, fX/FXa activity and thrombin-mediated platelet activation were fragile.

slots.clarification_sentence: This approach combines population-based phasing, genome-wide sequencing data or parental genotypes, and a large reference panel.

slots.claim_sentence: For population-based phasing approaches, performance is enhanced by adding genome-wide read data.
slots.clarification_sentence: Examples include whole genome shotgun and RNA sequencing reads.

slots.claim_sentence: Including parental genotype data in a population-based phasing strategy can reduce phasing errors.
slots.clarification_sentence: This inclusion can provide as much as a ten-fold reduction in errors.

slots.claim_sentence: The study identified DNA sequence signatures associated with genomic regions harboring phasing switch errors.
slots.clarification_sentence: These regions included areas of low polymorphism or SNV density.

slots.claim_sentence: Type-III ATPases enhance secretion efficiency.
slots.clarification_sentence: This enhancement occurs under limited secretion substrate concentrations.

slots.claim_sentence: ATPase activity is dispensable in the type-III protein export process.

slots.claim_sentence: The mechanisms that trigger the transition from dengue fever (DF) to dengue hemorrhagic fever (DHF) are not well understood.
This study performed mass spectrometry-based metabolomic profiling of sera from adult DF and DHF patients.
slots.clarification_sentence: The profiling was done during the critical and recovery phases of infection.

slots.claim_sentence: Twenty-nine differentially expressed metabolites were identified between DF and DHF patients.
slots.clarification_sentence: These differences were observed during the critical phase of infection.

slots.claim_sentence: These metabolites included bile acids, purines, acylcarnitines, phospholipids, and amino acids.
Bile acid levels were up to 5-fold higher in DHF patients compared to DF patients.
slots.clarification_sentence: These levels correlated with elevated aspartate transaminase (AST) and alanine transaminase (ALT), suggesting liver injury.

slots.claim_sentence: Uric acid, a major antioxidant in the blood, was 1.5-fold lower in DHF patients compared to DF patients.
Lower uric acid levels in DHF patients could lead to decreased antioxidant defense.
slots.clarification_sentence: This could also result in elevated oxidative stress.

slots.claim_sentence: Eight metabolites remained significantly altered in DHF patients during the recovery phase.
slots.clarification_sentence: This included chenodeoxyglycocholic acid, which is a bile acid.

slots.claim_sentence: Altered metabolite levels in the recovery phase indicate a potential prolonged adverse impact on the liver.
slots.clarification_sentence: This impact is due to dengue virus (DENV) infection in DHF patients.

slots.claim_sentence: The findings advance understanding of DHF pathogenesis mechanisms.
slots.clarification_sentence: They also allude to possible novel therapeutic targets for dengue management.

slots.claim_sentence: In embryonic stem (ES) cells, OCT4, SOX2, and NANOG transcription factors are essential for maintaining the cells' ability to differentiate.
slots.clarification_sentence: These cells can differentiate into any cell type of the developing embryo.

slots.claim_sentence: Combinatorial binding is strongly linked to the co-localization of the transcriptional co-activator Mediator in ES cells.
slots.clarification_sentence: This binding is also associated with H3K27ac and increased expression of nearby genes.

slots.claim_sentence: Genomic locations bound by Oct4, Nanog, and Sox2 in ES cells frequently drive gene expression.
slots.clarification_sentence: These locations are active during early embryonic development.

slots.claim_sentence: Less than 5% of individual binding events for OCT4, SOX2, and NANOG are shared between mouse and human ES cells.
About 15% of combinatorial binding events are conserved between mouse and human ES cells.
slots.clarification_sentence: Between 53% and 63% of combinatorial binding events at enhancers active in early development are conserved.

slots.claim_sentence: The combination of OCT4, SOX2, and NANOG binding is critical for transcription in ES cells.
slots.clarification_sentence: This binding likely plays an important role for embryogenesis by binding at conserved early developmental enhancers.

slots.claim_sentence: Fast evolutionary rewiring of regulatory networks mainly affects individual binding events.
slots.clarification_sentence: Gene regulatory hotspots, bound by multiple factors and active in early development, are under stronger evolutionary constraints.

slots.claim_sentence: Bacteria in biofilms have higher antibiotic tolerance than their planktonic counterparts.

slots.clarification_sentence: This profiling was done in biofilm and planktonic growth conditions, with and without tobramycin.

slots.claim_sentence: The study identified many mutations that contribute to antibiotic tolerance mainly in either the biofilm or planktonic setting.
slots.clarification_sentence: This offers insights into the differences and similarities between biofilm and planktonic antibiotic tolerance. The relative importance of most genes is state-specific.

slots.claim_sentence: The mixed population-based experimental design mimicked the complexity of natural biofilms.
slots.clarification_sentence: This design also revealed clinically observed behaviors, including the emergence of quorum sensing-deficient mutants.

slots.claim_sentence: The study revealed a substantial contribution of the cellular state to the antibiotic tolerance of biofilms.
slots.clarification_sentence: This provides a foundation for developing new treatments against P. aeruginosa biofilm-associated infections.

slots.claim_sentence: The study's calculations offer interpretations for the functional differences among these four groups.
slots.clarification_sentence: Different channel types have evolved to perform different tasks.

slots.claim_sentence: Noroviruses are a major cause of gastroenteritis in humans.
slots.clarification_sentence: Translation initiation is a critical early step in their replication cycle.

slots.claim_sentence: Norovirus RNA uses an unusual mechanism for protein synthesis.
slots.clarification_sentence: This mechanism involves its VPg protein interacting with host eukaryotic initiation factors (eIFs).

slots.claim_sentence: A ~20 amino acid stretch at the C terminus of murine norovirus (MNV) VPg directly binds to the HEAT-1 domain.
slots.clarification_sentence: The HEAT-1 domain is part of the eIF4G protein.

slots.claim_sentence: The motif in MNV VPg that binds to eIF4G HEAT-1 is conserved.
slots.clarification_sentence: This motif is found in all known noroviruses.

slots.claim_sentence: Mutagenic mapping suggests the MNV VPg C terminus may interact with eIF4G in a helical conformation.
slots.clarification_sentence: This interaction is crucial for the initiation of translation from the viral RNA genome.

slots.claim_sentence: The VPg binding site on eIF4G HEAT-1 is distinct from the eIF4A binding site.
slots.clarification_sentence: This allows norovirus VPg to form ternary VPg-eIF4G-eIF4A complexes.

slots.claim_sentence: Fusion proteins containing the C-terminal peptide of MNV VPg inhibit norovirus RNA translation.
slots.clarification_sentence: These proteins do not inhibit cap- or IRES-dependent translation.

slots.claim_sentence: The identified binding interface between norovirus VPg and eIF4G could be a target for antiviral therapy.

slots.claim_sentence: The study assessed the statistical information potential of different DNA 'word-sizes'.
slots.clarification_sentence: It also explored how oligonucleotide frequencies differ in coding and non-coding regions.

slots.claim_sentence: Prokaryotic chromosomes can be described by hexanucleotide frequencies.
slots.clarification_sentence: This suggests that information in prokaryotic genomes is encoded in short oligonucleotides. Oligonucleotide sizes larger than hexanucleotides possess little additional information potential.

slots.claim_sentence: Oligonucleotide usage varied more within AT-rich and host-associated genomes.
slots.clarification_sentence: This variation was mainly located in non-coding regions, compared to GC-rich and free-living genomes.

slots.claim_sentence: Bias in tetranucleotide usage correlated with GC content.
slots.clarification_sentence: Coding regions showed more bias than non-coding regions, indicating selectional pressure. Non-coding regions also carry information and are exposed to selectional pressures.

slots.claim_sentence: Non-coding regions were approximately 5.5% more AT-rich than coding regions.
slots.clarification_sentence: This was observed on average across 402 prokaryotic chromosomes. This difference may relate to DNA curvature in promoter regions.

slots.claim_sentence: GC-rich genomes were more similar and biased in tetranucleotide usage.
slots.clarification_sentence: This was true for non-coding regions compared to AT-rich genomes. GC-rich archaea and bacteria tended to have a less random DNA composition.

slots.claim_sentence: Differences between AT-rich and GC-rich genomes may be attributed to lifestyle.
slots.clarification_sentence: Host-associated bacteria showed more dissimilar and less biased tetranucleotide usage than free-living archaea and bacteria.

slots.claim_sentence: Receptive fields (RFs) do not fully capture the complex nonlinear network interactions that produce a cortical neuron's response.
A network receptive field (NRF) model was developed to fit cortical responses to natural sounds.
slots.clarification_sentence: This nonlinear feedforward network model revealed that primary auditory cortical neurons are sensitive over a larger spectrotemporal domain.

slots.claim_sentence: The NRF model consistently predicts neural responses to auditory stimuli better than standard receptive fields.
slots.clarification_sentence: The NRF is a network of 1–7 nonlinearly interacting sub-receptive fields.

slots.claim_sentence: The NRF model reveals separate excitatory and inhibitory sub-fields with distinct nonlinear properties.
slots.clarification_sentence: Their interaction enables operations like gain control and conjunctive feature detection.

slots.claim_sentence: Conjunctive effects mean neurons respond only if several specific features are present together.
slots.clarification_sentence: This enables increased selectivity for complex spectrotemporal structures and may be important for sound recognition.

slots.claim_sentence: Feedforward network models improve predictive power and reveal key nonlinear aspects of cortical processing.
slots.clarification_sentence: These models are also easy to interpret in a physiological context.

slots.claim_sentence: The Rho family of GTPases controls actin organization during various cellular responses.
slots.clarification_sentence: These responses include migration, cytokinesis, and endocytosis.

slots.claim_sentence: RhoA, Rac, and Cdc42 are primary members of the Rho family of GTPases.
slots.clarification_sentence: Their basic mechanism involves targeting the plasma membrane and activation by GTP binding.

slots.claim_sentence: GTPase cycling between the membrane and cytosol is key to their differential upstream regulation.
slots.clarification_sentence: This cycling is crucial for how these biochemical switches are controlled.

slots.claim_sentence: A modeling framework was developed to analyze experimental data for GTPase systems.
slots.clarification_sentence: The framework uses computational analyses.

slots.claim_sentence: This analysis can reveal details of GDI-mediated cycling.
slots.clarification_sentence: It also helps distinguish between GDI-dependent and GDI-independent mechanisms.

slots.claim_sentence: Analysis of Rac membrane cycling data shows GDI's lower apparent affinity for RacGTP.
slots.clarification_sentence: This is explained by the faster dissociation of RacGDP from the membrane.

slots.claim_sentence: The methodology was used to analyze glucose-stimulated Rac cycling in pancreatic β-cells.
The charts illustrate the effects of GEFs/GAPs on membrane-bound GTPase.
slots.clarification_sentence: They also show how regulated affinities between GTPases, membrane, and GDI affect this amount.

slots.claim_sentence: The epithelial-restricted αVβ6 integrin is upregulated during lung injury.
slots.clarification_sentence: Integrins are proteins that help cells attach to their surroundings.

slots.claim_sentence: β6-deficient mice (β6 KO) had increased survival during influenza infection.
slots.clarification_sentence: This was likely due to limited viral spread into the alveolar spaces, which reduced acute lung injury (ALI).

slots.claim_sentence: β6 KO mice had constitutively activated lung CD11b+ alveolar macrophages (AM) and elevated type I IFN signaling.
slots.clarification_sentence: This was traced to the loss of β6-activated transforming growth factor-β (TGF-β).

slots.claim_sentence: Administering exogenous TGF-β to β6 KO mice reduced CD11b+ AMs.
slots.clarification_sentence: It also decreased type I IFN signaling and eliminated the protective phenotype during influenza infection.

slots.claim_sentence: The protection in β6-deficient mice extended to other respiratory pathogens.
slots.clarification_sentence: These pathogens included Sendai virus and bacterial pneumonia.

slots.claim_sentence: The loss of the epithelial protein αVβ6 integrin can alter the lung microenvironment.
slots.clarification_sentence: This leads to reduced lung injury and improved survival during normal conditions and respiratory infection.

slots.claim_sentence: Our understanding of how cell-mediated immunity and T cell memory protect against respiratory viruses is incomplete.
Interleukin (IL)-6 is an important regulator of T cell proliferation and survival.
slots.clarification_sentence: IL-6 is a cytokine, a type of signaling molecule.

slots.claim_sentence: This study analyzed virus-specific T cell activity in wild type and IL-6 deficient mice.
slots.clarification_sentence: IL-6 is abundant after influenza virus infection.

slots.claim_sentence: The study reveals a new role for IL-6 in the development of T cell memory against influenza virus.
CD4+ T cell memory, but not CD8+ T cell memory, depends on IL-6.
slots.clarification_sentence: The absence of IL-6 diminished CD4+ T cell activity.

slots.claim_sentence: IL-6 suppresses CD4+CD25+ regulatory T cells (Treg).
Influenza-induced IL-6 limits the activity of virus-specific Tregs.
slots.clarification_sentence: This facilitates the activity of virus-specific memory CD4+ T cells.

slots.claim_sentence: IL-6 prevents antigen-specific Tregs from dampening the immune response during acute infection.
slots.clarification_sentence: This favors pathogen clearance and host survival.

slots.claim_sentence: Large-scale annotation efforts often involve multiple experts who may disagree.
This study proposes an approach to model disagreements among experts.
slots.clarification_sentence: The approach provides a confidence value for each annotation.

slots.claim_sentence: The approach computes certainty levels for individual annotations.
slots.clarification_sentence: These levels are based on annotator-specific parameters estimated from data.

slots.claim_sentence: Two probabilistic models were developed for this analysis.
slots.clarification_sentence: The models were compared using computer simulation and tested with a large dataset from human annotators.

slots.claim_sentence: The approach significantly increases the probability of choosing the correct annotation.
slots.clarification_sentence: This is true even when all annotators disagree.

slots.claim_sentence: A corpus of 10,000 sentences is made publicly available.
slots.clarification_sentence: These sentences are annotated according to several cardinal dimensions.

slots.claim_sentence: The 10,000 sentences were 3-fold annotated by eight experts.
slots.clarification_sentence: A 1,000-sentence subset was further 5-fold annotated by five new experts.

slots.claim_sentence: The modeling approach is general.
slots.clarification_sentence: Most data annotation studies could benefit from this methodology.

slots.claim_sentence: Andes virus (ANDV) and ANDV-like viruses cause most hantavirus pulmonary syndrome (HPS) cases in South America.
Passive transfer of convalescent human plasma shows promise as a possible treatment for HPS.
slots.clarification_sentence: However, the availability of convalescent plasma from survivors of this lethal disease is very limited.

slots.claim_sentence: The study explored using DNA vaccine technology to produce antiviral biologics for human use.
slots.clarification_sentence: These biologics are specifically polyclonal neutralizing antibodies.

slots.claim_sentence: Geese produce IgY and IgYΔFc, which can be purified at high concentrations from egg yolks.
IgY antibodies from geese lack properties of mammalian Fc that can cause reactogenicity in humans.
slots.clarification_sentence: This makes them potentially safer for human use.

slots.claim_sentence: Geese were vaccinated with an ANDV DNA vaccine encoding the virus envelope glycoproteins.
All vaccinated geese developed and maintained high-titer neutralizing antibodies for over 1 year.
slots.clarification_sentence: These antibodies were measured by a pseudovirion neutralization assay (PsVNA).

slots.claim_sentence: The study examined the protective efficacy of the goose-derived antibody in the hamster model of lethal HPS.
slots.clarification_sentence: The antibodies were passively transferred to hamsters starting 5 days after ANDV challenge.

slots.claim_sentence: Both immune sera and purified IgY/IgYΔFc from vaccinated goose eggs protected hamsters from lethal HPS.
slots.clarification_sentence: This protection occurred when administered post-exposure.

slots.claim_sentence: In contrast, all hamsters receiving IgY/IgYΔFc from normal geese or no treatment developed lethal HPS.
The DNA vaccine/goose platform can produce a candidate antiviral biological product.
slots.clarification_sentence: This product is capable of preventing lethal HPS when administered post-exposure.

slots.claim_sentence: New drugs are needed for Chagas disease because current medicines have toxic effects and partial efficacy.
slots.clarification_sentence: Existing treatments only target the acute phase of the disease.

slots.claim_sentence: There is currently no drug available to treat the chronic stage of Chagas disease.
Researchers optimized a whole cell-based assay for high-throughput screening.
slots.clarification_sentence: This assay helps find compounds that inhibit Trypanosoma cruzi infection in mammalian cells.

slots.claim_sentence: A chemical library of 2000 compounds was screened.
slots.clarification_sentence: The screening used a recombinant Trypanosoma cruzi (Tulahuen strain) that expresses β-galactosidase.

slots.claim_sentence: Three compounds, PCH1, NT1, and CX1, were selected.
slots.clarification_sentence: These compounds showed high activity against Trypanosoma cruzi and low toxicity to host cells in vitro.

slots.claim_sentence: Each of the three compounds affects the intracellular proliferation of Trypanosoma cruzi amastigotes.
slots.clarification_sentence: They do this through a different mechanism of action.

slots.claim_sentence: CX1 exhibits strong trypanocidal activity.

slots.claim_sentence: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) causes fever and severe joint and muscle pain.
Chronic musculoskeletal pain persists in many CHIKV patients for months to years after initial infection.
slots.clarification_sentence: The cause of this chronic disease is poorly understood.

slots.claim_sentence: Replicating virus is not detected in joint tissues during chronic disease.
slots.clarification_sentence: However, viral RNA is detected months after acute infection.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers developed a recombinant CHIKV, called CHIKV-3ʹ-Cre, to identify cells involved in chronic disease.
slots.clarification_sentence: This virus expresses Cre recombinase.

slots.claim_sentence: CHIKV-3ʹ-Cre induced chronic disease in mice, including persistent viral RNA and chronic myositis and synovitis.
Infection of tdTomato reporter mice with CHIKV-3ʹ-Cre resulted in tdTomato+ cells that persisted for at least 112 days.
These persistent tdTomato+ cells were mainly myofibers and dermal and muscle fibroblasts.
Treatment with an antibody against Mxra8 reduced tdTomato+ cells and chronic viral RNA.
slots.clarification_sentence: This implicates tdTomato+ cells as the reservoir of chronic viral RNA.

slots.claim_sentence: Sorted tdTomato+ fibroblasts from skin and ankle harbored most of the persistent CHIKV RNA at chronic time points.
The CHIKV-3ʹ-Cre and tdTomato reporter mouse system identifies cells that survive CHIKV infection.
slots.clarification_sentence: These cells are enriched for persistent CHIKV RNA.

slots.claim_sentence: The early steps of large ribosomal subunit production are among the least understood stages of eukaryotic ribosome biogenesis.
The Dbp6p helicase associates with a complex of four assembly factors in S. cerevisiae.
slots.clarification_sentence: These factors include Npa1p, Npa2p, Nop8p, and Rsa3p, and they associate before incorporation into 90S pre-ribosomal particles.

slots.claim_sentence: Npa1p forms the backbone of this complex.
Npa1p and Npa2p directly bind Dbp6p.
slots.clarification_sentence: Npa1p is essential for inserting the Dbp6p helicase into 90S pre-ribosomal particles.

slots.claim_sentence: Npa1p rRNA binding sites on 25S rRNA are adjacent to root helices.
slots.clarification_sentence: These root helices are part of the first and last secondary structure domains of 25S rRNA.

slots.claim_sentence: Npa1p and Dbp6p function in forming or clustering root helices of large subunit rRNAs.
slots.clarification_sentence: This process creates the core of the large ribosomal subunit RNA structure.

slots.claim_sentence: Npa1p also crosslinks to snoRNAs involved in decoding center and peptidyl transferase center modifications.
slots.clarification_sentence: These crosslinks occur in the immediate vicinity of the snoRNA binding sites on 25S rRNA.

slots.claim_sentence: The Dbp6p helicase and the Npa1p complex play key roles in 25S rRNA compaction.
slots.clarification_sentence: They also control snoRNA-pre-rRNA interactions.

slots.claim_sentence: The abundance of substrate receptor subunits of Cullin-RING ubiquitin ligases (CRLs) is tightly controlled.
slots.clarification_sentence: This control maintains the full repertoire of CRLs.

slots.claim_sentence: Unbalanced levels of substrate receptor subunits can sequester CRL core components.
slots.clarification_sentence: This sequestration is caused by a few overabundant substrate receptors.

slots.claim_sentence: Misregulation of substrate receptor components is associated with numerous diseases, including cancer.
slots.clarification_sentence: This is particularly true for SCF ligases, a large class of CRLs.

slots.claim_sentence: This study describes an additional pathway for regulating F-box proteins.
slots.clarification_sentence: Yeast Met30 was used as an example in this research.

slots.claim_sentence: This new ubiquitylation and degradation pathway acts on Met30.
slots.clarification_sentence: The pathway targets Met30 that is dissociated from Skp1.

slots.claim_sentence: The pathway required the cullin component Cdc53/Cul1.
slots.clarification_sentence: However, it was independent of the central SCF component Skp1.

slots.claim_sentence: This non-canonical degradation pathway is critical for chromosome stability.
slots.clarification_sentence: It also provides effective defense against heavy metal stress in yeast.

slots.claim_sentence: The results assign important biological functions to a sub-complex of cullin-RING ligases.
slots.clarification_sentence: This sub-complex comprises Cdc53/Rbx1/Cdc34 and is independent of Skp1.

slots.claim_sentence: Kinesin-3 motors transport synaptic vesicles and other membrane-bound organelles in neuronal cells.
Kinesin motors are inactive without cargo to prevent motility and ATP hydrolysis.
A previous model suggested that the Kinesin-3 motor KIF1A is monomeric when inactive.
slots.clarification_sentence: This model stated that activation occurs through concentration-driven dimerization on the cargo membrane.

slots.claim_sentence: This study found that both native and expressed KIF1A proteins are dimeric in their inactive state.
slots.clarification_sentence: The researchers used chemical crosslinking, coimmunoprecipitation, FRET, and photobleaching to confirm this.

slots.claim_sentence: KIF1A motors are not activated by cargo-induced dimerization.
KIF1A motors are autoinhibited by two distinct inhibitory mechanisms.
slots.clarification_sentence: This suggests a model for activation of dimeric KIF1A motors by cargo binding.

slots.claim_sentence: Monomeric KIF1A motors move by one-dimensional diffusion along the microtubule lattice.
Only dimeric KIF1A motors undergo ATP-dependent processive motility.
KIF1A may use both diffuse and processive motility for long-distance transport in neuronal cells.
slots.clarification_sentence: This dual ability is unique among kinesins involved in vesicle transport.

slots.claim_sentence: Cystic echinococcosis (CE) can affect the heart and the vena cava.
slots.clarification_sentence: Few cases of this condition are reported.

slots.claim_sentence: This study reports a retrospective case series of 11 patients.
slots.clarification_sentence: These patients had cardiac and/or endovascular CE and were followed for 15 years.

slots.claim_sentence: Main clinical manifestations included thoracic pain or dyspnea.
slots.clarification_sentence: Two patients were asymptomatic. Patients often experienced chest pain or shortness of breath.

slots.claim_sentence: Echocardiography was the diagnostic method of choice for cardiac and endovascular CE.
slots.clarification_sentence: Other tests like serology and imaging aided diagnosis and follow-up. Echocardiography is an ultrasound of the heart.

slots.claim_sentence: Nine patients underwent cardiac surgery.
slots.clarification_sentence: They also received long-term antiparasitic treatment for a median of 25 months.

slots.claim_sentence: One patient died intra-operatively due to cyst rupture.
slots.clarification_sentence: This led to endovascular dissemination.

slots.claim_sentence: Cardiovascular CE is associated with a high risk of potentially lethal complications.
slots.clarification_sentence: Cardiovascular involvement is associated with complications that may be life threatening.

slots.claim_sentence: Isolated cardiac CE may be cured after surgery.
slots.clarification_sentence: Endovascular extracardiac involvement is associated with severe chronic complications.

slots.claim_sentence: Cystic echinococcosis should be included in the differential diagnosis of cardiovascular disease.
slots.clarification_sentence: This applies to patients from endemic areas.

slots.claim_sentence: Protein Kinase A (PKA) is the main receptor for the cyclic adenosine monophosphate (cAMP) secondary messenger in eukaryotes.
CBD-B functions as a 'gatekeeper' domain that modulates the control exerted by CBD-A.
The study investigated the two-domain construct RIα (91–379) using Nuclear Magnetic Resonance (NMR).
slots.clarification_sentence: The construct was studied in its apo, cAMP2, and C-bound forms.

slots.claim_sentence: The NMR analyses led to a double conformational selection model.
slots.clarification_sentence: Each apo CBD dynamically samples both active and inactive states independently within a nearly degenerate free energy landscape.

slots.claim_sentence: The degeneracy of the free energy landscape explains CBD-B's sensitivity to weak interactions with the C-subunit.
slots.clarification_sentence: This degeneracy also explains CBD-B's high affinity for cAMP.

slots.claim_sentence: Binding of cAMP eliminates this degeneracy.
slots.clarification_sentence: cAMP selectively stabilizes the active conformation within each CBD and inter-CBD contacts.

slots.claim_sentence: The inter-CBD interface is indispensable for full activation of PKA.
slots.clarification_sentence: It occludes C-subunit recognition sites within CBD-A.

slots.claim_sentence: The two structurally homologous cAMP-bound CBDs show significant differences in their residual dynamics profiles.
slots.clarification_sentence: This supports that conservation of structure does not imply conservation of dynamics.

slots.claim_sentence: Inter-CBD contacts require both cAMP and W260.

slots.claim_sentence: The factors and regulatory mechanisms for meiotic gene expression in multicellular eukaryotes are poorly understood.
DUET/MMD1 functions as a transcriptional regulator in plant meiosis.
slots.clarification_sentence: DUET/MMD1 is a PHD finger protein essential for Arabidopsis male meiosis.

slots.claim_sentence: The interaction between DUET-PHD and H3K4me2 is critical for DUET's function during meiosis.
slots.clarification_sentence: DUET-PHD binds H3K4me2 in vitro.

slots.claim_sentence: DUET is required for proper microtubule organization during meiosis II.
slots.clarification_sentence: This function is independent of DUET's role in meiosis I.

slots.claim_sentence: DUET protein shows stage-specific expression.
slots.clarification_sentence: Its expression is confined to the diplotene stage.

slots.claim_sentence: TDM1 and JAS are identified as DUET targets.
slots.clarification_sentence: TDM1 is a direct target of DUET.

slots.claim_sentence: DUET functions as a direct transcription activator of the meiotic gene TDM1.
slots.clarification_sentence: DUET is required to regulate microtubule organization and cell cycle transitions.

slots.claim_sentence: Expression profiling showed reduced expression of about 12% of known meiosis preferred genes in the duet mutant.
The results reveal DUET's action as a transcriptional regulator during male meiosis in plants.
slots.clarification_sentence: Transcription of meiotic genes is under stagewise control in plants, similar to yeast.

slots.claim_sentence: The role of innate lymphocytes in immunity against Mycobacterium tuberculosis (Mtb) is not fully understood.
Researchers established an in vitro system to study innate lymphocytes and Mtb immunity.
slots.clarification_sentence: An in vitro system allows for studying cells outside a living organism.

slots.claim_sentence: Splenocytes from uninfected mice produced Interferon-γ when cultured with Mtb-infected macrophages.
slots.clarification_sentence: Under these conditions, bacterial replication was suppressed.

slots.claim_sentence: This innate control of bacterial replication depends on CD1d-restricted invariant NKT (iNKT) cells.
slots.clarification_sentence: iNKT cell activation requires CD1d expression by infected macrophages, as well as IL-12 and IL-18.

slots.claim_sentence: Even in limiting quantities, iNKT cells are sufficient to restrict Mtb replication.
To study host defense against tuberculosis in living organisms, iNKT cells were transferred into mice.
Primary splenic iNKT cells from uninfected mice reduced the bacterial burden in the lungs of Mtb-infected mice.
slots.clarification_sentence: Mice were infected with virulent Mtb by the aerosol route.

slots.claim_sentence: iNKT cells have a direct bactericidal effect.
slots.clarification_sentence: This effect occurs even without synthetic ligands like α-galactosylceramide.

The study aimed to map the distribution of Opisthorchis viverrini in southern Lao PDR. It also aimed to identify risk factors and predict prevalence in non-surveyed areas. The prevalence of Opisthorchis viverrini among 3,371 study participants was 61.1%. These participants had complete data records. Geostatistical models identified age, Lao Loum ethnic group, and educational attainment as risk factors for infection. A history of praziquantel treatment, access to sanitation, and living further from freshwater bodies were protective factors. The spatial patterns of Opisthorchis viverrini infection were primarily determined by environmental factors. Predictive modeling showed low risk in mountainous areas and high risk in the Mekong corridor. This study presents the first risk map of Opisthorchis viverrini infection in Champasack province. This map is crucial for spatially targeting control efforts.
